The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by the vanilla luck system. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. Stabilise the Water Pressure is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier, Power the Towers is considered Medium difficulty and has a 1.15x multiplier, and Burn the Blatodara is considered Hard difficulty and has a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

The Blatodara Swarm.

A large gazebo with a hole and pot next to the hole can be found either in the Fields or adjacent to the main entrance. After interacting with and pushing the pot into the hole, the Blatodara Swarm will be angered, rise from the hole, and cause walls to rise up and trap players inside.

Players must enable the four acid sprayers in the corners of the arena. To do so, players must turn all the switches on the panel attached to the the sprayer green. Each switch turns off or on another switch in a specific pattern, but the pattern generated is random. If successful, the acid sprayer will turn on.

The Blatodara Swarm deals 8 damage per hit to players that come into contact with it. The Blatodara Swarm will additionally form arms and hands to attempt to hit players with four different attacks:

  • Sweep - The Blatodara Swarm will sweep a hand slowly around two sprinklers, dealing 8 damage per hit to players that come in contact with it.
  • Spin - The Blatodara Swarm will spin three arms around the arena in one direction before spinning them in the other direction, dealing 8 damage per hit to players that come into contact with them.
  • Slam - The Blatodara Swarm will repeatedly slam three of its hands to the ground and create small aftershocks, dealing 15 damage per hit to players that come into contact with either.
  • Smack - The Blatodara Swarm will smack one of the acid sprayer panels, resetting it and dealing 8 damage per hit to players. There currently might be a softlock where the Blatodara Swarm can attack an inactive acid sprayer and cause it to effectively be disabled the entire fight despite players still being able to turn it on.

A relatively safe way to avoid most attacks or avoid accumulating too much damage is to crouch in the corners of the arena. Players can also jump onto the acid sprayers and jump above attacks like the Sweep and Spin. An extension ladder can be repeatedly placed near a wall and climbed to avoid all attacks as well.

After players keep the sprayers on for long enough and keep turning them back on after the Blatodara Swarm disables them, the Blatodara Swarm will violently explode and scatter. Afterward, the Blatodara commander can be found on the ground. This is the reward for the event. It is not conductive, weighs 0lbs, and is worth ▮196 to ▮239.
Hello! Welcome to the guidebook for Wesley's Moons. This should help point you in the right direction for getting started and advancing.

In the beginning of the mod, you'd have likely noticed you have currently one moon from the mod unlocked alongside all the vanilla moons. Routing to this moon, Galetry provides access to the beginner moons of the mod. Inside, you'll find the tapes for Motra, Infernis, and Asteroid-13. Bring these tapes up to the projector on the top-most floor, and the tape will play automatically. Take a seat and enjoy the video.

Now that you've watched your tape(s) you'll notice you unlocked the associated moon written on the tape's header side. You can now route there.

NOTE: There is currently a bug in Multiplayer, non-host clients cannot see unlocked moons at the moment. (Fixed?*)

Across the moons in the mod you'll notice Logs scattered through the map, They look like cassette players. To find these Logs, look for anything that might point you to it, they can tend to be surrounded by investigation equipment like floodlights and flares, if you start seeing tables and papers you are in the right area. These logs can then be carried to the Log Translator and translated into your ship's terminal. This is not the only effect however, in some instances, logs will provide a new route that you didn't previously have, this is not random. every log is set to provide something depending on which log it is.
These logs are not the only translatable item in the previously mentioned Log Translator. You can also log notes you find randomly in the interiors as Scrap.

Unlike a lot of other moon mods, Wesley's Moons utilizes a roguelike structure for progression.

Note: Some people may not like this system and that's okay; You can disable progression in the Config if desired, otherwise leave it enabled for the intended gameplay.

Without getting into spoiler territory the basic idea is just to go from one moon to the next, collect any loggables you can find, rinse, repeat.

If you don't mind spoilers and just want to unlock the moons in order you can find a full image of the progression tree here (Courtesy of WhiteA12, With help from Nagatonis), Log locations can be found on the maps provided in this wiki if help is needed.

So you've explored a good chunk of moons so far. "What do I do now?" I, Lambda hear you ask across the internet, Well something you might want to consider doing right now is searching for special Apparatuses.. Apparati? Ah Whatever

If you didn't know, near the left-side of the stairs in the back of Galetry there's a Hoarding bug statue you can push, that folds the stairs, and pushes the case back revealing the true inside of Galetry. Don't freak out because its dark or because there's a butler, he's friendly, name's Butch, if you push on and find where the Apparatus slots are, you can turn the lights on. And if you look at the slots, you can see what they'll take. Can you find out where to find them?

NOTE: Yes the stairs CAN kill you.

Before you leave Galetry. You may want to take a right from the ship's door. There's a gift shop you can visit and buy some items.

Your main focus right now is trying to find those special Apparatuses and plug them into the slots in the back of galetry. You don't have to find all of them in one quota, you can take your time, if you plug one into the slot, it will remain there between visits to Galetry, go at your own pace.

The Following moons contain these apparatuses needed to unlock one of the final moons.

  • Demetrica - Bloody Apparatus
  • Cosmocos - Cosmic Apparatus
  • Calist - Royal Apparatus
You're approaching the ending! Congrats! This assumes you're at the point you're at the point that you now have access to Hyx

Hyx is a dangerous moon, especially later. staying out of the ship in later parts of the day is essential, that crater in front of the ship is not for decoration.

Navigating Hyx can be really hard especially for your first time, but walking forward from the ship, on the ridge allows you mostly direct access to the facility, you can also walk in the red substance without taking damage of any kind, as dangerous as it looks.

What you're looking for here at Hyx is the Empra Video tape. Which sports a spawn weight of 10, it is not guaranteed to spawn unlike some sources say.

Now that you got the tape and watched it back at Galetry, You need a minimum of 2500 credits to go that fancy new moon. Take your time, there's a certain scrap or two you're gonna want:

  • A single normal apparatus, hold on to that
  • A "Huge Harold", Don't question it

Now that you have both of these items, there's a store item you're going to want, hence why I said a "minimum" to route here, You'll want a jetpack. for a total of 3400, not including a discount on the jetpack.

Now that you have all of those, follow these steps, Courtesy of "ChaoticPyre" for writing the following section:

  1. Plug an apparatus to the cart
  2. Place the Huge Harold on the designated slot in the cart
  3. Ride the cart into Empra's plaza
  4. Redirect the mortar
  5. Jetpack to the control tower
  6. Fire the mortar from the control tower NOTE: Make sure every other crewmate is back home at the ship, this step can be fatal, you're safe up there.
  7. Move the crane
  8. Lift the tracks
  9. Ride the cart back home, send it off, jump off, QUICK.
  10. Drive the cart into the overseer and watch the fireworks and the ending cutscene.

Now that you've officially beaten the moons, and watched that hell of a cutscene, you're now in freeplay, do whatever you want, make quotas and explore the other moons. When or if you're fired, you keep all of your moons, so if you get fired at any point you will keep your progress.

Have fun and best of luck.

- Absolute Lambda

Hailey Robertson, also referred to as just Hailey, is a hostile entity and variant of the Ghost Girl added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. She resides in a coffin that opens to reveal her decayed corpse. She has hollowed out eyes, blonde hair, and a short blue dress.

There is little to no difference between the Ghost Girl and Haily Robertson. She will appear behind her targeted player accompanied by the sound of her coffin creaking, muffling the player's audio if they look at her. After her targeted player has looked at her at least twice or ignored her at least three times, approaching, looking, or staring at her can cause her to begin chasing that player. She will decapitate and instantly kill that player on contact.

While Hailey Robertson does have some possibly intentional instances of not being harmful to the player, such as her coffin showing up directly in the ship, she can be quite buggy. For example, she can sometimes get stuck and be visible moving in place on the exterior while trying to go after her targeted player. That said, it's better to be cautious when seeing her over assuming she is harmless.

Hailey Robertson will begin haunting the player that picked up any of the Secondary Objective Rewards from the Rubber Rooms. Spooky sound effects will randomly be played followed by a message next to the player's stamina bar, which is Hailey Robertson speaking to them. This haunting persists across all moons barring moons like Galetry and Gordion.

Eventually, Hailey Robertson will announce her prescence with the player's screen turning red and getting a fear effect. This action spawns her as an entity. She will disappear upon returning to orbit. However, she can spawn once per reward grabbed and continue haunting players if multiple rewards are picked up. This can also apply if players pick up a medallion again after dropping it in the ship, typically after the save file is reloaded.

After Hailey Robertson first spawns on a save file, players will receive this entry about her.

Hailey ⁠
HAILEY ROBERTSON

First name: Hailey
Last name: Robertson
Middle name: -

Gender: F
Age: 32

Occupation: Nurse
Establishment: Crosswind Mental Hospital
Place: Last Hope

Cause of death: Poisoning

Hailey Robertson was found deceased in the treatment room of the Crosswind Mental Hospital, She had signs of physical abuse, lacerations to the back and chest, and a small hole was discovered in her forehead.

A notebook was recovered from a burning bin containing a detailed log of the experiments she was put through. Among which were, being forcefully exposed to violent videos of human torture for days on end without breaks. Being suffocated to the edge of death causing minor brain damage. Having her solve complex logic puzzles within certain timeframes and being punished for failing.

She was often reminded how her four year old son would not be able to survive without her as she was a single mother. This was with the promise of her being let go if she complied.
Unfortunately he also died of starvation during her capture.

A tiny rod was used to destroy a small part of her brain which likely led to her losing any sort of self. This was one of the final experiments listed within the notebook.

Hailey Robertson was one of many victims of such experiments and life altering treatments by the hands of Solover Underhill, the head psychiatrist of the Crosswind Mental Hospital.

She was a loving, hard working mother who had a hard time following her husband’s passing. She was full of courage and remained positive even during her hardest times.
She will be remembered by all.
May she Rest in Peace.

Heaps of trash, the largest disposal area in the region. A place housing disease, parasites and insects at a concentration higher than the most vile places. If you've ever lost something, there's a good chance its here. Disposed. Vanished. Rumors say it wasn't only used to dispose of trash but bodies too.

POPULATION: Abandoned.

CONDITIONS: Warm, moist, large amounts of trash.

FAUNA: A struggling ecosystem, dominated by insects.

Heap is a massive landfill and its entire terrain is almost entirely covered in hills and mounds trash. Some of this trash includes cars with sometimes functional car alarms, shipping containers, etc. Rubble can be heard dislodging and falling from trash and breaking randomly as well.

Three large cranes can also be seen on the exterior and can be used as landmarkers to help in finding the three large buildings on the exterior, which are the main entrance and fire exits. The crane to the west and slightly south marks the main entrance, the crane to the northwest is to the left of a fire exit, and the hook of the crane to the southeast is placed roughly above another fire exit.
Heap supports Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, and Minefield weather by default.

Heap naturally generates mines on its exterior. These mines begin beeping faster when a player enters its range and will explode if a player stays too close for too long. Players can safely trigger these mines without taking damage, but they can also deal 30 damage to players or instantly kill players and most entities depending on the proximity to the blast.

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can crash onto Heap's exterior near the main entrance. If players land on Heap in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

The Honey Stinger is a hostile or docile entity depending on how players interact with it and is a variant of the Hoarding Bug added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. It is a large black and brown bee with a stinger, a pair of wings, four longer arms it uses to crawl around, and two shorter arms it uses to grab items.

While the Honey Stinger behaves very similarly to the Hoarding Bug for its Roaming, Guarding, and Attacking states, the Honey Stinger specifically only attempts to find and collect Bee hives. The Honey Stinger becomes more aggressive and territorial of its nesting area the more hives it collects. If several hives are collected, the Honey Stinger will often attack players it encounters on sight. The Honey Stinger deals 30 damage on contact in its Attacking state.

A Honey stinger treat is randomly available for purchase from the Gift Shop on Galetry for ▮520. It is not conductive, weighs 21lbs, is two-handed, and is worth ▮130. The tooltip mentions that it can be offered to the Honey Stinger as a treat and tribute. If players encounter a Honey Stinger, they can drop the treat on the ground for it to collect. The Honey Stinger will become permanently happy and docile on that save file after collecting it, never attacking players and allowing players to safely take hives they have collected.

However, the tooltip also mentions that the Honey Stinger will remember if players betray it. Players can betray the Honey Stinger by directly attacking it, such as with a shovel. Indirect actions like dropping a conductive item to strike it down with lightning does not count as betrayal. If players do betray the Honey Stinger, it will immediately aggro every time it encounters players on that save file.

The Honey Stinger has a chance to spawn on several moons, most commonly spawning on Hyve.

HONEY STINGER


Sigurd's danger level: 40%


Scientific name: Vapir-Mellitera


The Honey stinger is a large insect part of the Anthophila, being close to the Melittidae. They tend to inhabit luscious or mountainous areas with the largest colony discovered in the asteroid belt of 56-Vow.
The honey stinger has a hard and thick shell on its back to protect itself from any aggressors while the bottom is more soft and vulnerable. It is because of this vulnerability that they prefer to crawl around despite them being excellent at flying.


Much like many species of bees they are born from and serve one queen. While the antics of the honey stinger are not extensively studied, it is known that they possess a more playful behaviour than most other families of bees.


They take a liking to grabbing and claiming objects they find interesting. Most often these are beehives of smaller species of bees. It is unsure if they understand the concept of a smaller version of themselves existing but it is known that after obtaining several of these hives they become increasingly defensive.


While they do not have any aggressive tendencies towards most species they are quick to attack any human who wanders near them, likely due to the frequent exploitation of their hives.


It is recommended to stay away from the honey stinger when encountered in the wild. They do not like you but they mean no harm. They are only protective of themselves and their hives.

sections.html: Hyve/Asteroid-14 is home to the largest bee colonies in the region. Many companies have attempted to harvest honey from the massive beehives here. The locals however were not fond of intruders.

POPULATION: Abandoned.. for good reason.

CONDITIONS: Rocky terrain highly populated by bee hives.

FAUNA: Bees, lots and lots of bees.

Also known as Asteroid-14.

Hyve has rocky terrain with patches of tall brown grass, flowers, and an overwhelming number of bee hives that range from small to colossal in size. Several small lakes of honey can also be found around the exterior that generally hinder the movement speed of players, and this honey can be present in the interior depending on what interior is generated. The ecosystem is dominated by bees, including species like the Honey Stinger, and they can be seen flying overhead or around their hives.

Buildings with hexagonal tiling resembling honeycombs can also be found around the exterior. The buildings northeast, southeast, and south of the ship are fire exits while the taller building northwest of and behind the ship is the main entrance.

Hyve can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

Hyve experiences a unique Foggy weather. A swarm of bees will continously surround players in a circular formation with a denser and darker shade of fog, though it being pitch black in some instances may be unintended. Though the bees will always follow the player, the fog can still be flown out of with a jetpack.

Hyve also experiences a unique Flooded weather. Instead of the water level rising throughout the day, a swarm of gigantic bees will move from the far right side to the far left side of the exterior throughout the day. Players that go too deep into this swarm of bees will rapidly take 3 damage per hit and have drastically reduced visibility. The player is not safe within the ship, and the bees envelop the ship around 04:00pm and pass at around 04:30pm. It is possible to fly over the bees safely with a jetpack.
On Hyve you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Hyve's exterior has many large hives that can be broken by driving the cruiser into them. This will spawn several additional Circuit Bees and hives that can be collected for scrap as usual. Breaking these hives can also spawn entities, such as Honey Stingers and Old Birds.

Hyve's interior has hives on pedestals that can not be collected as scrap. At 06:00pm, bees begin expanding and contracting around this hive. Any player that steps within the area the bees are around will rapidly take 3 damage per hit.

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Hyve's exterior. If players land on Hyve in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

Inserting the Hyve videotape that can be found within breakable hives on the exteriors of Centrus, Chasm, Faith, Filitrios, Glace, Lecaro, Motra, or Release into the projector in Galetry. Lecaro is the only moon that is guaranteed to spawn a breakable hive.
Alternatively, the Hyve videotape randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Vow.

sections.html: Hyx has been consumed. Do not under any circumstance go here. It is watching. It will not rest until it's done. Never. Go. Here.

POPULATION: Assimilated.

CONDITIONS: Watched.

FAUNA: The Overseer is here.

Hyx has been completely assimilated by The Overseer, who can be seen floating above the moon looking down on players and moving as time progresses. The terrain is made up of yellow ish rocks, strange rock formations, a goopy red substance, and large craters scattered around the landscape. The goopy red substance is also part of the waterfall, river, and lakes and functions as quicksand. The south portion and end of the river has this quicksand trigger above the red goop, causing players to sink through the solid ground on the shoreline.

A forested area can also be found in the west portion of the moon, which is connected to the rest of the exterior by bridges. The trees have tendril-like growth coming out of them. The main entrance can be found west and slightly north of the ship in the forest, surrounded by strange glowing rocks. Three other buildings and fire exits can be found in the forest southwest, northwest, and north and slightly west of the ship. The last fire exit can be found southeast of the ship.

In Hyx's interior, several creatures and body parts can be found completely assimilated. They can be collected as scrap.
Hyx plays ambience in the background while on the exterior. The Overseer can also be heard on the exterior and in the interior.
Hyx can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, or Earthquakes weather by default.
The Overseer in the distance.

The Overseer can hear and feel players while they are on Hyx, progressively getting angrier as the day progresses and while players are running, using a jetpack, etc., on the exterior. Each time The Overseer is angered, he will roar and several tentacles will appear on the exterior.

Addtionally, The Overseer can randomly unleash colossal tentacles from the large craters of a red substance. These tentacles will target and track a player before slamming down. These tentacles have a hitbox on the bottom and top ends of the tentacle, making a portion of the center of the tentacle safe. Any player that comes into contact with these hitboxes will take 999 damage per hit. Excluding the ship, these tentacles can damage players through obstructions.

Hyx's interior has several hazards that mostly aid in Hyx's primary gimmick, Assimilation. This is functionally similar to Cadaver Growth Infection, but it takes significantly longer at a baseline for Assimilation progress to reach 100%. Getting hit by most of Hyx's hazards also increases Assimilation progress significantly. Any player that does reach 100% Assimilation progress will shortly die and spawn an Assimilated Employeee, a variant of the Cadaver Bloom with 28hp that similarly only takes 1 damage from all sources.

For a list of interior hazards:

  • An Assimilated Growth will immediately spawn in the interior upon landing. It is a variant of the Cadaver Growth that can not be destroyed and builds up Assimilation (infection) at a comparatively much slower rate.
  • Sets of three tendrils coming out of a red substance and yellowish rock on the ground, dealing 15 damage per hit to players and building up Assimilation.
  • Tentacles coming out of the floor, ceiling, and walls from yellowish rocks that deal 20 damage per hit to players that come into contact with them and build up Assimilation.
  • Markings that look similar to a red X on yellowish rocks will lash out with tendrils when a player walks near them, dealing 15 damage per hit and building up Assimilation. These can deal upwards of 90 damage if a player stands in them for the full duration they're active.
  • A small red circle on yellowish rocks will lash out with a tentacle and scan around the area when a player is near it, dealing 20 damage per hit. This hazard does not build up Assimilation on its own but does decrease player hp to speed up its progress.
  • A red subtance will periodically fall from yellowish rocks on the ceiling to the floor. This substance deals 1 damage per hit to players and builds up Assimilation.

Lashing Tentacle

Hyx was originally advertised as a vacation destination to experience the wonders of nature. It has since been entirely "assimilated" by The Overseer, a cosmic entity and the primary antagonist of Wesley's Moons.

These logs can be found by interacting with five Databoxes on the exterior. In order of the log number, these can be found at the main entrance, at the fire exit southeast of the ship, at the fire exit north and slightly west of the ship in the forest, southwest of the ship in the forest near one of the fire exits, and northeast of the ship near a lake. They document the full timeline of the moon's assimilation.

Text ⁠
The Corruption of Hyxellia
—--------------------------------------
Documented timeline of recorded events since the initial meteoric impact.
> The Beginning
The Employee
The Officer

—--------------------------------------
[This a detailed construction of events put together through interviews and reports with those involved]

The Beginning - 0 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
In the town of Rosemaw, a small hike into the forest a meteor fragment had impacted.
It is not unusual for small fragments to reach the surface and make contact so it wasn’t immediately reported by the public.

A few days later a few hikers had noticed an unusual looking fungus but chose to leave it be. These hikers only began to take notice once it started spreading and growing over a small patch in the forest. They didn’t think much of it and avoided the area for the time being.

The Employee - 4 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
Richard Pollar, more commonly known as Rich, arrived at the local bakery for work an hour before opening time. He started preparing the kitchen for the day, organising and cleaning the kitchen when he noticed red blobs of an unusual liquid sticking to the equipment and the furniture.
The liquid was thick and lukewarm to the touch, a gooey substance. Rich was both intrigued and disgusted by the discovery and went looking for the source. He couldn’t find anything else out of the ordinary until he got to the stove. He was frightened by what he saw. It was a rat covered in tendrils with strange goop oozing from one of its empty eyesockets, bubbling and twitching as it did. Before Rich could fully understand what he was looking at, it scurried away, fleeing to someplace outside.
He was shaking and frantically called his employer before loosely explaining what happened.
Rich was quickly dismissed with the assumption of it being another one of his psychotic breaks.
Meaning to prove that what he witnessed was real, he went to chase it down, leaving a note for the other employees explaining where he went.
Rich followed the trail of goop through the town, into the forest all the way to the area where the fungus was spotted by hikers before. There he found it, laying still on this yellow-orangish rock. Rich was bemused and stared at it for a while. He assumed it was dead considering its state and the fact it wasn’t moving anymore. The only movement he saw were these small tendrils sticking out of its body.
Unsure of what to make of it he decided to investigate, he was scared but his curiosity carried him forward. The fungus he had heard about has seemingly spread through a significant chunk of the forest.
As Rich wandered through the infested area, he laid eyes upon more of these critters in a similar condition. Witnessing this he got scared and ran back towards the bakery and told his coworkers, who had arrived by this time, what he had seen. To ensure they would believe him he had taken some pictures to show.
The coworkers seemed very concerned upon being shown the pictures. Similarly confused and disgusted they decided to investigate on their own, leaving Rich at the bakery, who at this time was still shaking.
An hour passed and Rich grew concerned, maybe they got lost, maybe they were still investigating, who knows. But he grew more and more concerned by the minute. Another hour later he finally made the decision to call the authorities. Fearing they’d dismiss him if he spoke the truth, he only said there was an emergency at the bakery. And there he stayed until an officer arrived.

The Officer - 4 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
An officer by the name of Michael Benson, Mike for short. Arrived at the scene finding a distressed Richard sitting in the bakery. Mike asked about the emergency to which Rich tried to explain that his coworkers left to investigate something in the forest but hadn’t returned for hours. Mike grew suspicious and calmly asked why he’s as distressed as he is. Rich told Mike there’s horrifying things happening in the forest around the infested area.
Mike called this in and went to have a look for himself, unsure if he was telling the truth. But only after a few more officers arrived at the scene.
Mike arrived at the forest and cautiously took a few steps in when he already began to see signs of something being off.
The ground was covered in yellowish rock with this red substance oozing out of the ground. Slightly deeper into the forest, plants seemed to turn gray, die or get covered in this same yellow rock.
Mike returned to the edge of the forest and called for a search party. This has to be reported, it has become a real anomaly he thought. Half an hour later four more officers arrived and the search started.
As Mike ventured deeper into the forest he began to see the same things Rich had described, Critters, seemingly deceased with tendrils erupting from their bodies. Starting to get a notion of dread he continued. As he stumbled further into the woods it became less and less lively.
Then he noticed something red, moving away from him, sliding across the rocky ground, leaving a trail of that same red substance. As Mike got closer the picture got clearer, it was similar to the critters he had seen earlier. When he walked in a big circle to the front of it he saw what it really was.
It was the front half of a moose, a large tentacle slid out of its mouth alongside a significant amount of red ooze. Where its back half was meant to be was nothing but tendrils and intestine slowly moving it forward.
Frightened, Mike quickly stepped back. He wasn’t sure what to do. It looked like it was trying to scream or yell but no sound erupted from its mouth. Another tentacle protruded through one of its eyes, pushing it out of its socket followed by blood and ooze.
Now horrified, Mike grabbed the weapon out of his holster and fired a bullet into its head, meaning to end its suffering.
It ceased to move for a moment but quickly got back to it, now oozing from the wound.
Mike was filled with dread and ran away from there. On his way back he found something else.
The missing employees laid there, lifeless on the hard rock surface. He called it in and told the other officers to head back. The employees were in a terrible condition, it looked like their limbs had torn themselves from their bodies, oozing out of their eyes and mouths. Witnessing this he ran back immediately and met up with the other officers in the bakery. This has quickly turned into a seemingly deadly fungal invasion.

The I.T.D.A. - 7 days since impact.
—--------------------------------------
The town has been evacuated and all survivors involved have been brought in for questioning and isolation. The I.T.D.A. Has labeled this situation as critical and has begun quarantining the area. Nobody was allowed to enter or leave the quarantine zone. The military had been called in for additional security.
Several teams of experienced biologists and scientists had made it to the site to analyze and halt the anomalous threat. It was immediately proven not to be any sort of fungi but something else that had yet to be documented. This spread seemed to overtake whatever they put in front of it, consuming it entirely. Attempts of halting the spread were made such as burning it which only temporarily made the tendrils disappear. They had attempted several other chemical solutions to no avail. The closest they had gotten was by using a liquid which super freezes anything it comes into contact with. It only significantly slowed it down.
From this point several nearby towns were also evacuated as the spread and the quarantine area grew. Slowly but surely the area was becoming a wasteland.
It was discovered that direct contact with the substance could result in an infection which ends in a grueling eruption of tendrils, torn limbs and death.
The I.T.D.A. had officially labeled the spread as a world-ending level hazard. And as there have been no viable methods to halt the spreading or cure anyone infected. The I.T.D.A after a discussion with the Council of Rule on Calist, had marked Hyxellia as a moon in quarantine. Nobody could enter. Nobody could leave. Those who tried were either stopped or killed.
The population remaining on Hyxellia were scared, unable to send out or receive communication from a source outside of the moon, the only source they had were the I.T.D.A. which assured the public that the threat will be dealt with.
Biologists had well documented the workings of this spread which has gained the name “The Red Death”. In a detailed report it was documented how the red death consumed and spread:
The yellow rock-like material isn’t technically stone as many assumed but more similar to a very thick, dense, solidified skin. Instead of being stretchy, the density makes it much harder and rock-like. Below the yellow crust is a much softer meat-like material, this material is able to retract or expand, even move as if it’s one large living being organising its fleshy layer. This soft layer has seen to form these tentacles or tendrils for either defensive or even offensive measures. The spread itself is quite unique, these cells will attempt to eat whatever is around them and immediately replace the consumed material with a new cell. The process of consumption also generates this red substance. Drilling procedures have noted that deep inside the soft layer there’s large tunnels where the substance flows similar to our veins. The substance which gets generated doesn’t always end up within these veins, it often surfaces and forms large bubbles of goop below the crust, sometimes bursting through, leaving holes within the crust and forming large puddles of goop.
At the two week mark, the Red Death had consumed nearly half the moon. The cause seemed lost. This was the end times. Anyone still on Hyxellia was awaiting a horrible fate with no way of saving them.
Many military personnel as well as teams sent in by the I.T.D.A. have chosen to end their own lives to avoid a worse end.

Hyxellia had been nearly entirely consumed and the I.T.D.A. had ceased any further attempts at rescuing the moon.
Following this the I.T.D.A. had sent out a message to Calist, where the council would decide over the fate of the moon.
The response was immediate and due to the level of contagiousness of the Red Death, the council had decided to not only keep the moon in quarantine but also silence anyone aware of the situation.
Hyxellia was to be removed from the star maps and public knowledge entirely as if it had never existed in the first place. They had gone through great lengths to achieve this.
Nearing full corruption, few reports were sent out by biologists in hopes they would be rescued.
They spoke of having heard sounds from deep space, calling them cosmic, possibly a language they couldn’t understand. They said it felt like something was watching them. Something beyond what they could understand. Something they couldn’t feel but only feel its presence of.
In the final moments of life on Hyxellia, a warning was sent out:
“Stay away. It is watching us. It sees us. It will come for us all.”
Hyx is a threat, well documented and hidden.

[These documents have been classified by the Council of Rule]
Under no circumstance can they be released to the public.
They will be kept on Hyxellia to ensure no living being is able to access them.

Translated Messages can randomly be found as scrap within the interior and are translations of The Overseer talking about its plan and success in using the Emperor as a puppet ruler to cause a war and destabilize the region to continue assimilating worlds unimpeded. Although not mentioned in these logs, the "spark", or catalyst, was the Triton military's destruction of Calist ordered by Agent Geoffrey at the request of the Emperor after the Council of Rule refused to allow the study and usage of biological weapons.

The Ice Leviathan is a hostile entity and variant of the Earth Leviathan added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. It is a brown, colossal, and long worm with a toothless and split jaw it opens to swallow things whole when feeding or defending its territory.

Similar to the Earth Leviathan, the Ice Leviathan is located underground and will roam around until a player above it is nearby. It will then chase that player, indicated by the rumbling of the Ice Leviathan below them. If the Ice Leviathan attempts to attack, the ground will start shaking and it will launch out of the ground into the sky at a random interval before crashing back down again. Any player or killable entity in the path of the Ice Leviathan when it attacks will die.

The Ice Leviathan has an 18.33% chance to spawn in the interior and a 54.27% chance to spawn on the exterior of Glace. It additionally has a 20.50% chance to spawn on the exterior of Polarus, although Ice Leviathans also act as map hazards there.

Ice Leviathan ⁠
ICE LEVIATHAN

Sigurd's danger level: ??? idk I have n veer seen tehm

Scientific name: Iciteren-gigantis

The Ice leviathan, being part of the family Piscicolidae is, similarly to the Earth leviathan among the largest invertebrates in the Thistle Nebula. While there have been equally little recorded captures of this creature, there have been a lot of discoveries made since the expedition in the glacial caves of 94-Polarus, which they have made their home.

While it is often assumed that these leviathans primarily hunt land-dwelling prey due to their occasional appearances above the earth. It is quite the opposite.
Their jaws do not have any teeth but instead have baleen which they use to filter out nutrients from vast frozen oceans.
It is only in desperate times when they resort to hunting for prey on land. However they might also appear when their breeding grounds are threatened. Be wary of sudden vibrations as you might not immediately realise you are walking above one.

Ice leviathans primarily burrow themselves within deep sheets of ice, carving out large sections creating these ginormous unnatural caverns as resting and breeding places in between feeding sessions. Using their extremely hard and thick skin to break through the ice.
They have to move often due to the nutrient supply not replenishing quick enough to sustain the leviathan.
An ice leviathan will only ever make one breeding cavern in their lifetime, it is often much larger than resting caverns and it is always the place they return to when mortally wounded, or when they are approaching the final months of their life. They will stay there until death occurs. It is not known why. The common theory is that Ice Leviathans share a sentimental value with the area where they birthed their young.

The Infected Bunker Spider is a hostile entity and variant of the Bunker Spider added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. It is a large white spider with black markings and two spikes of white mold on its body.

Similar to a Bunker Spider, an Infected Bunker Spider will initially attempt to create a nesting area by placing several webs in the surrounding area and will typically stop if it encounters a player until line of sight is broken. Once all the webs have been laid down, the Infected Bunker Spider will find a spot to wait until one of its webs is triggered, a player walks underneath it, or it is attacked by a player. It will then pursue that player.

Players that come into contact with the Infected Bunker Spider will take 90 damage. Additionally, the white mold spikes on the Infected Bunker Spider rapidly deal 4 damage per hit to players on contact. Any player that dies to either attack will be cocooned and hung from the ceiling, although the Infected Bunker Spider typically is encountered on the exterior and the body will instead be hung on thin air. Regardless, the body can only be recovered via the ship teleporter.
The Infected Bunker Spider only naturally spawns on Vindict, having a 36.04% chance to spawn on the exterior during daytime and a 39.62% chance to spawn in the interior.

The Infected Bunker Spider can additionally spawn immediately on the exterior of one or several moons depending on if players let ResearcherxB crash or decide to overload it. If players let it crash onto Trite, several Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day every time players land on Trite afterward on that save file.

If players instead decided to overload the ship, debris from the ship can fall onto the exteriors of several moons. A couple or few Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior of the moon every time players land on it afterward on that save file. The moons currently known to have a chance for debris to fall onto their exteriors are Carnate, Core, Crowd, Dune, Glace, Heap, Hyve, Infernis, Junic, Selector, and Utril.

Players will receive an entry about the white mold growing on the Infected Bunker Spider rather than the entity itself.

White mold ⁠
WHITE MOLD


Scientific name: Cretyrus-botaharum


This is a dangerous species of mold which thrives in bright areas. It is capable of growing in dark places but prefers not to, very rarely it be found in shadow or complete darkness.


The mold grows en masse and is able to spread across large surfaces with rapid succession. Additionally, on occasion it clusters up and grows spike-like formations which act as a way of detecting motion and a means to spread itself through direct infection of any poor creature which gets stung by it.


The spike-like formations are able to sense both heat and vibrations through the air. It knows what sort of creatures are easier to spread through and which are not. Those it deems not viable, it tries to scare off by shaking its spikes. However it will not hesitate to sting when the opportunity arises regardless of what steps on it.


Unlike most infections, this one does not try to kill or harm the host, instead it tries to adapt to its host and strengthen the skeleton or exoskeleton, making them bulkier and more violent as a faster method of spreading to other creatures through the addition of spikes growing out of the bones it has strengthened. Comparisons have been made with Rabies lyssavirus, a disease which similarly alters behaviour to become more violent as a means to spread.


The I.T.D.A. has investigated several infestations of this mold and deemed it not to be a critical level invasive species and has successfully cleared large patches of the mold.
They highly advise everyone to report any instances of the white mold appearing and avoid direct contact.

sections.html: Infernis was previously used for the mining of crystals and other various materials. But due to the increase of volcanic activity all sorts of insects infiltrated the facilities to seek refuge. Every employee within the building at this time was either devoured or cooked by the extreme heat.

POPULATION: Deceased.

CONDITIONS: Extremely hot, Dry dusty terrain, Rarely supports living plant life due to recent volcanic activity.

FAUNA: A desperate ecosystem, remaining creatures support agressive behaviour.

Infernis has hot and dry terrain with little signs of plantlife beyond red bushes. Several large crystals are scattered across the landscape and a ring of lava surrounds the exterior. Its most prominent landmark is the large volcano that can be seen behind the ship, which periodically shoots out molten rock that crashes onto the exterior. This volcanic activity causes dust to scatter in the interior and reduce visibility. When the ship leaves Infernis, the volcano will erupt and the lava will rise and cover the exterior.

Four square shaped buildings can be found around the exterior, which are the main entrance and fire exits. The main entrance is on the right-hand side of the pathway that is behind and to the left (south) of the ship. A fire exit can similarly be found by going straight from the main entrance and past the floodlight on the ground. Another fire exit can be seen southeast of the ship, but requires a relatively difficult jump, tools like a ladder or TZP, or finding the exit within the interior to push a stalgamite and create a bridge to make the exit accessible. The last and southwest fire exit can be found by going to the path behind the ship and heading left to a short parkour above lava.

Infernis can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

If Infernis experiences Rainy weather, steam will be present on the exterior and can reduce visibility.

If Infernis experiences Stormy weather, the lava and lava crystals on the exterior will be blue. This is just a visual change.
Infernis has a unique music track that plays after landing on the moon.
The lava on the exterior acts like quicksand and rapidly deals 10 damage per hit. If players fall into the holes with lava at the bottom, they will instead take 20 damage per hit.

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto the exterior of Infernis near the path behind and to the left (south) of the ship. If players land on Infernis in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

Any poor soul out there is currently being fried in the fiery rains of death.
If we don't call in rescue..
We might not see the light of day again.

Image & Text ⁠
We were able to reach out to one of those giant emergency service centers on Polarus.
One of those near the overly protected vaults.
I wonder what kind of crazy stuff they hide in there.
Anyway, rescue is on the way. We're scared but only a few more hours and we will be safe.

Image & Text ⁠
We heard noises in the walls.
A buddy of mine went to investigate one of the vents and..
There were so many of them..
The bees they..
I can still hear his screams as they were digging into his eyesockets and flying into his mouth.
If rescue won't come quick, I don't know what else might follow.

Image & Text ⁠
They're everywhere!
Bees, spiders and whatever else lived out there.
I think they killed most of the people here.
I'm heading out the fire exit to wait outside.
It's that or getting eaten alive in here..
Tell my family I love them.

Head straight behind the ship and turn right at the first crystal. A map of Atlantica will be on the ground further down the path between three crystals. Interacting with this map will cause a voice to start speaking and unlock the moon afterward.

Image & Text ⁠
From the bay through the temples, across the porcelain bridges, the sinking city awaits.

This videotape will always spawn within the museum of Galetry.

Text ⁠
Tape 1, Infernis.

This is Captain Commander Cunningham.
I have decided to start recording our sites of research and the environments we find ourselves in.

Our current location is Infernis.
This fiery hellscape has done nothing but slow us down.
The seismic activity here is quite high so I'm not expecting to stay long.
Good thing.
The mineshafts are riddled with bugs and are very much preventing us from doing anything.

I rate this place a B+.
Cunningham, signing off.

Loggable items are the foundation of Wesley's Moons lore. Almost all of them can be found on their moons as random scrap within the interior or in special spots on the exterior. Some of them can even unlock moons.
Loggable items have a unique icon in your inventory when you grab them.
Currently, there are 135 loggable items.

  • Vanilla moons
  • Crowd
  • Narcotic
  • Descent
  • Extort
  • Release
  • Duckstroid-14
  • Berunah

Ingredient items are scrap items that you can put into the crafting machines (a.k.a., fabricator)) on Galetry and Gratar. Depositing the ingredients into the machines will process the materials and add resources to the machine that can then be used to craft Untampered operating panels (Gratar only), Blanky floppy discs (Galetry only), Triangulation devices, Double-barrel shotguns, Shotgun shells, Adrenaline-stims, Health-stims, Pulatrum spore-emitters, Boomboxes, Advanced-flashlights, Fog-reducers, Radar-boosters, Action figures, Weed killer, De-weed, Pesticide-sprinklers, Fabricated keys, and Single-barrel shotguns. Resources are shared between both machines and resources will be saved even after being fired.

Ingredient items have a unique icon in your inventory when you grab them. Currently, there are 8 ingredient items and 8 large ingredient items. However, Large plastic stock is likely not obtainable through legitimate means currently as it is not in the scrap table for Fission-C and is instead in the Unused Items section.


All ingredient items ARE NOT two-handed but all large ingredient items ARE two-handed.

sections.html: Deep in the deadly jungles of Junic there where ancient temples where ancient rituals were performed. This place is very attractive to archeologists due to the many artifacts that remain here. However they might not have fully understood what they were dealing with.

POPULATION: Several tribes detected, no human life in designated area.

CONDITIONS: Warm, very lush terrain, supports plenty of flora, always sunny.

FAUNA: A very healthy ecosystem, fauna exhibits neutral behaviour.

Unfinished Section

This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section.
Junic can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.
On Junic you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Junic's exterior has several small and large roses that temporarily trap any player that walks into them. The small roses will deal 22 damage to the player while the large roses will deal 90 damage to the player before releasing them. Additionally, Junic's exterior is somewhat foggy and can be confusing to navigate due to rocks and trees that fall and block pathways at specific points in time if a player is nearby.

Near one of the fire exits, there exists a ritual circle on the ground. To reach it, head straight from the back of the ship and turn right, turn left into a narrow pathway, continue walking along the path until the next intersection and turn left, and follow the path until reaching the fire exit and ritual circle. Entering this circle normally will result in a short cutscene and death. During that cutscene you can hear voice of Devils of Junic.



However, if the player holds the scrap "Jack's skull", which randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Junic or is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry, the player will survive. A new shortcut between the fire exit and the ship will be unlocked, the exterior and interior will emit a red glow, and the player will see a dramatically different exterior. Additionally, another path opens up near the back right of the ship and to the left of the log translator. Following this path shows a giant cubic skull and unlocks Roart.

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Junic's exterior. If players land on Junic in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

Logging "Geoffrey's final message" found on the exterior of Asteroid-13.
Alternatively, inserting the Junic videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Acidir, Alcatras, Gloom, Hyve, or Vow into the projector in Galetry.

Acidir: Acidir videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Chasm: Interact with the note found on the wall of a tent on the exterior.
Etern: Log "Geoffrey's log 4" found on the exterior.
Gloom: Gloom videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Roart: Complete the ritual described in Junic's moon exclusive content and approach the hidden cubic skull.

Text ⁠
Last night..
I heard the news..
The cities of Trite have been made one with the ground.
They bombed almost the entire moon!
And now they are laying waste to whomever survived the attack.

I send out many MANY messages to ask for my family.
The emperor has refused to answer. How weird I thought.
But ooooh those left on Trite sure answered!

They told me there were no reports of anyone arriving from Calist before or after the Catalyst.

My family.. my children.. my Maddy.
They never even left in the first place.

No effort was made to even try to get them out of there in time.
And the emperor has been lying to me!
He has been lying to me since the very start of this hell!
I thought he may have had it all planned out but this.. grand war.
All that I have done..
I should never have trusted him.

I am ceasing the operations here.
And I will be moving into my final mission but I won’t be following his plans.

Agent G- Signing off.

Image & Text ⁠
I thought I would write about our findings.
During the excavation we laid eyes upon an ancient golden mask.
I bet this is worth millions considering where it came from!

It was perhaps used by the ancient people of this moon.
Not quite sure what for however. I do feel it has a creepy look to it.
Maybe my fellow archeologist Jack might have an idea.
Here's a sketch:

Image & Text ⁠
Yesterday Jack claimed to have found an ancient dagger.
He was eager to tell the crew but he does not want to let go of it.
This is quite strange behaviour for Jack so I went to investigate this blade.

He left it next to his bed while he was asleep.
I snuck in and tried to grab it but.. It was incredibly heavy.
Which is weird considering jack was able to carry it fine.
However, in his sleep, I heard him mumble about some ancient note or.. ritual..
Certainly strange.

Image & Text ⁠
I AM IN SHOCK!
When Jack came in earlier he was completely covered in blood!
He has lost his mind!
He was holding the dagger in his right hand and the mask in his left held before his face.
He looked at me.
Chanting soem unrecognisable words before he walked away. Seemingly heading outside.

I am not sure if he killed an animal or..
I need to make sure Dave is ok.
I don't want to be alone with Jack the lunatic.
Maybe I should go look what's outside.

I fear the worst.

The Key Wielding Nutcracker is a hostile entity and variant of the Nutcracker added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. As its name implies, it looks very similar to the Nutcracker except it has a brighter colored coat, a hollowed out eye, and a key around its neck.

The Key Wielding Nutcracker behaves identical to the Nutcracker, having the same patrolling state, scanning state, attacking state, etc. The most notable differences are the bloody visual effects that comes out after the shotgun is fired and the scrap dropped, being the Bloody shotgun, up to two Bloody Ammo, and the Toy vault key. The first two are functionally identical to the Shotgun and Ammo respectively, and the ammo works for reloading any shotgun, but killing a Key Wielding Nutcracker is the only legitimate way to obtain any of this scrap.

The Key Wielding Nutcracker will almost immediately spawn in the interior if the Kill the Key Keeper objective is generated in the Toy Store. This spawn does not contribute to total Power Level, and the Max Count and Power Level of the Key Wielding Nutcracker only matter if players modify spawn tables to spawn the Key Wielding Nutcracker elsewhere.

The Lasso Man is a hostile entity and variant of the Jester added by Wesley's Ememy Variants. This entity is not to be confused with the other appearances of the Lasso Man in the Art Gallery and the unused vanilla entity Lasso. To add to this confusion, both entities seem to share the same Internal ID, though Wesley's variant can also be referred to generally as RunningLasso.

Regardless, the Lasso Man is a tall humanoid creature made of red rope and string. Its head and the ends of its arms are circular and used as nooses to kill players.

Unlike the Jester, the Lasso Man will almost immediately enter its chasing state after spawning regardless of if it actually has seen a player or not. It will chase the closest player and instantly kill them on contact. However, its maximum speed is significantly reduced, only being a bit faster than a player walking.

After all players leave the interior, the Lasso Man will roam around the interior at a significantly reduced speed until spotting another player. The Lasso Man has a following timer and cranking timer of 1 second, meaning it will almost immediately enter its chasing state again after seeing another player.

The Lasso Man is primarily encountered in the Lost Corridors event in the Art Gallery, where it is guaranteed to spawn from the painting in the reward room after a player passes a trigger point at and near the door leading into the room.

The Lasso Man can also naturally spawn on a few moons, though this should be taken with a grain of salt given the confusion surrounding its Internal ID as well as the vanilla Lasso, who is also in each of these tables, being incapable of spawning without commands or external modifications.

sections.html: Lecaro is an asteroid orbiting Infernis, on the surface it seemed like not more than a volcanic wasteland. But deep inside there was a large deposit of crystalline wonders. Very attractive to the many mining companies in the region. Unfortunately they were not prepared enough for the dangers of this asteroid.

POPULATION: Suffocated.

CONDITIONS: Extremely hot, Dry dusty terrain, Rarely supports living plant life.

FAUNA: A desperate ecosystem, remaining creatures support agressive behaviour.

Lecaro can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, or Hallowed weather by default.

When Lecaro experiences Rainy weather, steam will be visible on the exterior.

When Lecaro experiences Stormy weather, the lava and lava crystals on the exterior will be blue.
On Lecaro you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Lecaro's exterior always spawns a shovel behind the ship to break Lecaro's unique map hazard, "Stalagmite", which one always spawns behind the ship as well. These Stalagmites can also be broken with a knife and a Pickaxe, a shovel variant and custom scrap Wesley's Moons adds, breaks them in one hit. To the right of the main entrance there are large gunpowder barrels that explode when hit with a knife or shovel. Many more Stalagmites and gunpowder barrels can be found within the interior, but the gunpowder barrels in the interior are lit when hit instead of exploding immediately.

Lecaro's exterior has a minecart to the right of the main entrance that can be used to transport players and scrap between the main entrance and the ship. While the lever at the main entrance can be pulled to have the minecart travel in either direction, there isn't a lever at the ship and the player instead interacts with and pushes the minecart back to the main entrance. There is a geyser underneath and between a gap in the tracks that triggers any time a player is detected above it that rapidly deals 69,420 damage per hit to players to prevent simply running and jumping across the tracks instead.

Lecaro's exterior has large rocks that spawn in fixed positions that, for the most part, randomly fall when a player walks underneath it. This will crush any player underneath it for 999 damage and block off that path for the rest of the day as these rocks can not be broken.

Numerous stalactites will spawn above or on the roof of the interior. These are normally not visible to the player, but can be seen in interiors with high ceilings like the Grand Armory. When a player walks underneath a stalactite, there is a chance it will begin falling and the roof will shake and scatter dust as a warning. It will then fall into the interior and any player underneath it will be crushed for 999 damage. This will then create a Stalagmite as an obstruction, which can be broken as usual.
Interacting with the map found on the exterior of Atlantica.

Thalasso: Once the stalagmite is broken, stick to the right. Get past the river of lava and keep right. Before reaching the fire exit, there will be a small opening on the left with the map. Interacting with this map will cause a short cutscene and unlock Thalasso. Note that a rock will fall on top of the map shortly after the cutscene, crushing the player.

Hyve: Once the stalagmite is broken, hug the left wall until getting back outside, head up the hill on the right, and a hive will be straight ahead on a different rock. This is also near one of the fire exits. A jetpack or extension ladder is required to reach the hive and breaking it reveals the Hyve videotape.
Oldred: Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

Image & Text ⁠
Below the ocean surface, deep in the drowning chamber, a secret tunnel remains, in the temples of Thalasso.

Image & Text ⁠
It has not been a couple hours since I entered this abandoned mineshaft. And already something feels off. If not for the missing equipment in the supply area, it would be the distant rumbling giving me a sense of unease. Maybe I should just shrug it off and get what I came here for.
A large deposit of various crystals is what attracted me to this place.
I've been short on money and I'm slowly heading into debt. If I'm able to find what I'm looking for it could really help me out. I don't know how deep they are but I know for certain that they're there.
There's no mineshaft here for nothing.
I'm heading in deeper.

Image & Text ⁠
I was uneased before, now I'm scared.
I have seen some of the equipment scattered around the caverns. Abandoned by whomwever used to work here. Possibly left in an emergency I thought. But then I started seeing bones and bodies.
There were empty birdcages sitting on the floor about an hour back. My theory is that there might be something toxic in the air. Possibly some sort of gas leak. Suffocating everyone who was down here at the time. It could be in the air still.
Either way, I need to make it quick. The rumbling is getting closer. And I do not entertain what that could mean.

Image & Text ⁠
The earthquakes are getting louder and I can hear parts of the cavern collapsing in the distance ahead of me.
The amount of bodies I have seen have left me horrified. While some of them were slumped over. Others looked like they were trying to run.
It's getting harder for me to breathe. And my legs are getting tired.
I have found a few crystals of value. Not many but I should not succomb to my greed. This deposit is lost and I don't want to die trying to find it.
I'm turning around and heading back. I want to see my cat Bean again.
I just need to remember the way I came.

I think I got this thing workin'
Might serve me some entertainment in these caves
It's not easy spendin' all day down here
Can't see the sun, can't read the time
It's actually quite sad
Diggin' for these shiny crystals and I don't even know what they are
They were sendin' birds in earlier
Haven't heard from them since
Ah, well
Better get back to work

sections.html:
Mrov bought McDonalds.
He's here

POPULATION: happy customers

CONDITIONS: bleak.

FAUNA: oh if only you knew.

MorvDonalds is a specific rocky moon featuring rough landscapes, some several plants, crystals, dead trees and MorvDonalds's building. If you played Lethal Company with Wesley's Moons before you probably noticed that moon's surface is similar to Infernis and Lecaro - two volanic like moons that you can unlock during your journey. Upon exiting the ship, when you go straight you'll see MorvDonalds's building which is similar to how Mcdonalds restaurants look. If you stop and go left instead of going to main entrance, you'll be close to one of fire exits also crystals will lead you to it. Fire exits on this moon are untypical because they don't look like they're connected to a building. It's similar to how main entrance on Hyx is presented. Another and last fire exit is located on the other half of the map. When you'll be standing in front of main entrance and then go right and straight down the path, you'll find the second fire exit.
MorvDonalds supports Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Hurricane, Forsaken, Hallowed and Earthquake weather by default.
This moon contains only one unique scrap item which is Mrov Sauce. It is the most common scrap item on this moon.
This moon has its own unique interior that spawn here only. It has 99.9997% chance to spawn. Interior looks like McDonald's restaurant.
This moon is unlocked by default.
This moon does not unlock any other moon.

This moon features a trial that generates on the exterior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮320. The specific rewards are several "Small diamond" and one "Medicate the unwell ticket" scrap.

To complete this trial:

  1. Enter the warehouse straight behind the ship.
  2. Grab the gas canister next to the machine hooked up to the employee, carefully follow the line connected to the machine to the correct generator, and fuel it with the gas. Fueling the wrong generator will cause the player to die via blast.
  3. Exit this warehouse and follow the yellow signs to a different warehouse. This other warehouse is located in front of and to the left of the ship.
  4. Retrieve two acid canisters from this warehouse. Inside your vision will be clouded with a TZP-like effect and you will hear auditory hallucinations, but it is non-lethal.
  5. Return to the warehouse with the employee inside it, pour both acid canisters into the machine, and wait for the employee to die. The rewards will spawn on the floor in front of the employee.

sections.html: Oldred is one of the most valuable moons in the system. Not for its many riches but for its remarkable amount of oil. For this reason, during hard times of death and destruction, oil extraction sites were made. But nobody knew how big of a mistake this was until it was too late.

POPULATION: Deceased.

CONDITIONS: Hot thin terrain, no surviving flora, high pressure within outer crust.

Oldred can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.
On Oldred you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.
Oldred's exterior has geysers of boiling oil that shoot upward periodically, primarily on the catwalks. These geysers rapidly deal 3 damage per hit to any player that walks into them.

Oldred's interior has a unique map hazard called a "Hanging mine". These mines deal 10 damage to any player that walks into them. Throughout the day, a blast radius will pulse out from a mine accompanied by a beeping sound. The blast radius will then pulse out again and the beeping sound will increase in speed before the mine explodes. Any player that is within the blast radius when the explosion occurs will take 70, 90, 99, or 9,999,999 damage depending on the proximity to the mine itself. The explosion goes through all obstructions.

Polarus features an elevator, a ladder, moving platforms, and five fire exits. The exterior is massive, featuring a frozen lake with breakable ice platforms.

Polarus can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

If Polarus is Eclipsed, the Ice Leviathan that is in the area with the two fire exits to the front left of the ship will not be present. Instead, a meteor will enter the atmosphere at 02:00pm and crash into this area at around 05:00pm. Any player nearby will die and any player within a large radius that extends all the way to the ship will quickly take 20 damage per hit. Approaching and inspecting this meteor will unlock Desolation.
On Polarus you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Shortly after landing, an Ice Leviathan can be seen launching upward from the back of the ship to an area in front of the ship. When the player leaves the moon, an Ice Leviathan can again be seen launching upward from the back of the ship and it will proceed to attempt to devour the ship. This is purely visual.
Polarus's exterior has an Ice Leviathan that moves through the area where the two fire exits in front and to the left of ship are located roughly every 20 seconds. Any player in its path will die.

On the frozen lake behind and below the ship are noticeable patches of ice. Ice Leviathans can break two patches of this ice when players approach or stand on them, while the other three patches of ice will break when a player stands on them for too long with too much weight. Some of the ice is also slippery, causing players to move faster in one direction but making it significantly more difficult to slow down or turn.

Additionally, icicles can fall onto players in the canyon paths in front of the ship. Any player that gets directly hit by an icicle will die.

The pathway that leads to the two fire exits to the front right of the ship will begin randomly closing when a player walks through them. Any player will be crushed by these moving walls, though it can be survivable due to clipping issues. This makes these fire exits inaccessible without a jetpack or finding them in the interior for the rest of the day.
Logging "Cunnigham's travel log 3" found on the exterior of Acidir.

Desolation: Visit Polarus while it is eclipsed. There will be a meteor in the sky that appears at around 02:00PM and crashes at around 05:00PM. Inspecting the meteor will unlock Desolation.

First, my findings on Gratar.

Because I’ve found it.

I’ll heal you.
I only need the opportunity.
And then we’ll be one again.

Cunningham. Signing off.

This moon features a trial to complete that generates with the Expanded Facility interior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮360. The specific rewards are the scrap "Bloodied diamond" and "Reshape the incapable ticket".

To complete this trial:

  1. Though not required until the final step, it is advised to find a door with a sign that says "RESHAPE THE INCAPABLE" and remember its location.
  2. Find a room with an employee trapped in a machine and remember its location.
  3. Find and return three "Machine parts" scrap to this room and insert them into the machine. These parts spawn in smaller server rooms with shelving units behind electrical gates. These electrical gates will deal 99 hp to the player if they walk through them while holding machine parts. The intended method to avoid taking damage is to place the parts onto a small platform, walk through the electrical gate and around to the other side of the platform, and rotate the platform to safely transport the parts. However, dropping the parts near the electrical gate, walking through the gate, and grabbing the parts from the other side is much simpler.
  4. Press the red button in the room with the employee, grab the gas can underneath it, and find a generator within the interior to fuel with the gas. The generator typically spawns in rooms adjacent to catwalks with a sign saying "BACKUP POWER".
  5. Return to the room with the employee, press the red button again, and wait.
    6. Once the employee has been "reshaped" and a loud buzzer sound plays, return to the door in step 1. It will now be opened.

Additionally, completing this trial can reward the player with two different destiny items that can be inserted into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress.

Ending 5: Turn on the TV in the room after beating the trial and watch. The destiny item "Secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine next to the TV afterward.

Ending 6: The player must have previously completed the trials on Crowd, Narcotic, Descent, and Extort to get their respective tickets as rewards. In the room after completing the trial, insert all five tickets, including Release's ticket acquired in this room, into the machine to left of the TV as prompted before turning on the TV. The destiny item "Very secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine shortly after turning on the TV. Submitting any less than all five tickets will result in Ending 5.
Inserting the "Reshape the incapable" videotape that spawns randomly as scrap within the interior of Extort into the projector in Galetry.

Hyve: A breakable hive has a chance to spawn directly north of the ship at the top of the hill in front of the fire exit, spawning the Hyve videotape when broken.
End: Acquiring the destiny item "Secret Coordinates" or "Very secret Coordinates" and placing it into the destiny item slot before taking off in the abandoned ship on Repress.

The following content contains major spoilers for completion.

Repress's exterior has an abandoned ship the player can repair and power to take off in. An apparatus, two oil barrels, and an untampered operating panel are required to do so. The appratus can be found within the Facility, Expanded Facility, and Fractured Complex interiors. The oil barrels can randomly spawn as scrap within the interiors of multiple moons, but most commonly spawn on Oldred and Repress. The untampered operating panel is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry for ▮7000, can be crafted on Gratar, and randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Empra or Hyx.

To the left of the main entrance, insert an apparatus to open the door at the end of the wire. To the left of the ship in this room, place two oil barrels to fuel the ship. Once fueled, turn towards the monitor, interact with the keypad, interact with the top lever, interact with the bottom lever, and interact with the top lever again to move the ship outside. Run straight out of this room to reach the ship, jump inside, and place the untampered operating panel onto the terminal. If a destiny item has been collected, it can be inserted into the slot to the left of the terminal. Regardless, taking off will cause a cutscene to play and transport the player to the back of the ship once finished. This process is required to complete any ending.
This moon is unlocked by default.

Gratar: Gratar videotape that has at least one guaranteed spawn within the interior.
End: Repairing the abandoned ship found on the exterior and placing any destiny item into the destiny item slot before taking off. A destiny item can be acquired on Berunah, Carnate, Empra, Release, or Utril.
