plain.p-end: The End. POPULATION: you? End is not a traditional moon and serves as the credits for Wesley's Moons. Time does not pass and landing does not count as a day towards the current deadline, although players will be fired upon returning to orbit when landing here on Day 0. Immediately upon landing, the credits will begin rolling and can not be skipped. Once finished, players can explore around the building and find various hazards and objects from many moons and interiors on display. When facing away from the back of the ship, players can go into the right hallway to reach an area with the library and electric chair from the Rubber Rooms on display. This area also has five buttons on the wall that will spawn weapons and entities to fight in this area: Wave 1: Two shovels and two Thumpers. Wave 2: Two shovels, one Butler, and one Thumper. Wave 3: Two loaded shotguns with the safety off, eight shotgun ammo, one Butler, and four Thumpers. Wave 4: Two loaded shotguns with the safety off, eight shotgun ammo, two Butlers, two Nutcrackers, and two Thumpers. Wave 5: Two loaded shotguns with the safety off, eight shotgun ammo, one Jester, three Nutcrackers, and two Thumpers. Every wave can seemingly be infinitely spawned, so players can freely farm knives, shotguns, and shovels on End. Inserting any destiny item into the destiny item slot before taking off in the abandoned ship on Repress . A destiny item can be acquired on Berunah , Carnate , Empra , Release , or Utril . This moon does not unlock any other moons.
plain.p-endings: Spoiler Warning This page contains spoilers . View at your own discretion. Wesley's Moons has six different endings that can be achieved. The majority of these endings require unlocking a specific moon or moons. Every ending requires routing to Repress to repair and power an abandoned ship on the exterior. Progress for doing this will be reset upon returning to orbit. An apparatus, two oil barrels, and an untampered operating panel are required to repair the ship. The appratus can be found within the Facility , Expanded Facility , Fractured Complex , and Decrepit Store interiors. The oil barrels can randomly spawn as scrap within the interiors of multiple moons, but most commonly spawn within the interior of Repress. The untampered operating panel is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry for ▮7000, can be crafted on Gratar , and randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Empra or Hyx . To the left of the main entrance, insert an apparatus to open the door at the end of the wire. To the left of the ship in this room, place two oil barrels to fuel the ship. Once fueled, turn towards the monitor, interact with the keypad, interact with the top lever, interact with the bottom lever, and interact with the top lever again to move the ship outside. Run straight out of this room to reach the ship, jump inside, and place the untampered operating panel onto the terminal. If a destiny item has been collected, it can be inserted into the slot to the left of the terminal. Regardless, taking off will cause a cutscene to play and transport the player to the back of the ship once finished. Ending 1 is the simplest ending to achieve, as players do not need a destiny item and just take off in the abandoned ship on Repress. To get this ending you must first acquire 3 special apparatuses, these apparatuses are: -The Bloody Apparatus which is acquired from Demetrica - Once you land on Demetrica buy either a jetpack or ladder and then proceed to the dome, you'll come to a 3 way fork going left or right will take you towards the main entrance but going straight is where the apparatus is, if you go straight you will enter a square room, dying inside this room without opening the other door will cause the room to become inaccessible for the rest of the day . As soon as you step foot in this room the path behind you will close and a trap will activate in the room, this trap comes in the form of two blocks/walls that stay on the lower level they move counter-clockwise and when they hit a wall they will briefly stop and turn, being in the way of one of these traps will kill the player, so as soon as you enter use the jetpack/ladder to get onto the upper level where the apparatus is, on the opposite end of where the player enters is a door, this door is the way out of the room, and is a unique door, the player can go down and interact with it which will fill up an interaction meter that stays between interactions, once that meter is full the door opens, alternatively and the most recommended option is to bring a key which will immediately open the door or a lockpicker which will open the door after 30 seconds, once this door is open this room will be accessible for the rest of the day and you can take the apparatus at any point. -The Cosmic Apparatus which is acquired from Cosmocos -The Royal Apparatus which is acquired from Calist After acquiring an apparatus you must bring it back to Galetry where you will then insert it into its respective reactor slot inside the secret back room accessed by interacting with the loot bug statue in the back left next to the stairs, once all three have been inserted a new room will open up, inside the room will be a tape for the moon Hyx insert that into the projector and then proceed to the planet, once you're on Hyx proceed into the interior and keep your eye out for a tape there's always one guaranteed to spawn, this tape goes to the moon Empra . Once on Empra there will be a few steps you must do after taking the cart over to the entrance: 1. Before heading inside the interior, there's a mortar on the left side that must be lowered go up to it and interact with it. 2. Once inside look for the fire exit that takes you out to an upper area that overlooks the cart this is where the crane controls are, there's a button to fire the mortar do that while you're here and then remember where the door is at you will be back here. 3. Now you will want to find two items in the interior the apparatus (word of advice if you have any special interiors installed and they have custom apparatuses you will not be able to continue, it must be the base apparatus), and you will also need to find the nuke, once both have been found take them to the cart and place them in their respective spots. 4. Head back to the crane controls are and get the crane into position, after its in position head down to the cart and head back to the ship, once back at the ship just send the cart back without you on it, after a bit a cutscene will play (this cutscene is not the ending), after the cutscene ends there will be an item that spawns on the ground near the ship called Chunk of Harold, this is a destiny item, grab it and head off to orbit. Players will achieve Ending 2 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. Ending 3 is the most complex ending to achieve and follows a mysterious voice guiding the player to various locations. First, players should get access to Berunah . Berunah can only be unlocked by following the specific progression route through Dreck , Core , and Faith . Do not route to Berunah after unlocking it. Next, players need to access Cubatres and retrieve the "Crystal cube" scrap found on the exterior near one of the fire exits. Cubatres can only be accessed through Utril . Players should now route to Berunah with the cube. After the sandstorm passes on the exterior, a stairway will be revealed directly in front of the main entrance door. Going down this stairway will lead to an area with an interactable statue on the left side. After interacting with this statue, inserting the cube into the hole the statue's light is shining through will reveal a hidden chamber. Inside will be five brooding seeds and a glowing eye at the end of the chamber. Players must return all these brooding seeds to the ship, but can also approach the eye for an explanation on what to do with these seeds and this explanation will be logged in the ship terminal. Players must place the brooding seeds onto altars on the exteriors of Etern , Filitrios , Fission-C , Gloom , and Utril . Check the Progression section on each moon page to see the specifics of unlocking each of them, and it is highly recommended to unlock and route to Alcatras for the highest chance at finding the Gloom videotape. Placing the brooding seeds will display a warning message and permanently alter the exteriors and interiors of these moons on that save file until the player is fired. Berunah's exterior will also be altered once all five brooding seeds are placed. After placing all five brooding seeds, players must return to Berunah and the hidden chamber. A "Chunk of Overseer" will now be in the hidden chamber. Near the main entrance, a lever that a statue is looking at will now be interactable nearby. This will raise up the shrine of purification to insert the chunk into, and a cutscene will play shortly afterward. After the cutscene, the destiny item "Stone of purification" will spawn behind the ship. Players will achieve Ending 3 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. Ending 4 is the quickest of the five endings that provide destiny items to complete and follows the story of a character named Professor Harrington. "Harrington's Research 4" is a destiny item that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Utril . Players will achieve Ending 4 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. For players that wish to understand and experience the story, it is recommended to unlock and route to Cosmocos and Desolation and find logs there as well. Ending 5 follows the experimentations done by the Trite Control Corporation and requires completing a unique trial on Release . Release can only be unlocked by following the specific progression route through Crowd , Narcotic , Descent , and Extort . It is important to note that while all of these moons have trials, only Release's trial is required to complete this ending. To complete this trial: 1. Though not required until the final step, it is advised to find a door with a sign that says "RESHAPE THE INCAPABLE" and remember its location. 2. Find a room with an employee trapped in a machine and remember its location. 3. Find and return three "Machine parts" scrap to this room and insert them into the machine. These parts spawn in smaller server rooms with shelving units behind electrical gates. These electrical gates will deal 99hp to the player if they walk through them while holding machine parts. The intended method to avoid taking damage is to place the parts onto a small platform, walk through the electrical gate and around to the other side of the platform, and rotate the platform to safely transport the parts. However, dropping the parts near the electrical gate, walking through the gate, and grabbing the parts from the other side is much simpler. 4. Press the red button in the room with the employee, grab the gas can underneath it, and find a generator within the interior to fuel with the gas. The generator typically spawns in rooms adjacent to catwalks with a sign saying "BACKUP POWER". 5. Return to the room with the employee, press the red button again, and wait. 6. Once the employee has been "reshaped" and a loud buzzer sound plays, return to the door in step 1. It will now be opened. After completing the trial, interact with the TV in the now open room. The destiny item "Secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine next to the TV afterward. Players will achieve Ending 5 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. Ending 6 follows the experimentations done by the Trite Control Corporation. It requires completing the trials on Crowd , Narcotic , Descent , Extort , and Release and acquiring the unique ticket scrap from each of them. Players will progress to each moon in the listed order. For the sake of not bloating this guide and making it overwhelming, please read the specifics on completing each trial in the Moon Exclusive Content section of each moon page. For Release's trial specifically players can also read Ending 5 on this page. Do not attempt Release's trial until all other tickets have been acquired. Once Release's trial is completed and the reward room has been unlocked, do not interact with the TV before inserting all five unique trial tickets into the machine next to the TV as prompted. Submitting any less than all five tickets will result in Ending 5. Interacting with the TV after submitting all five tickets will instead spawn the destiny item "Very secret coordinates" in the machine next to the TV. Players will achieve Ending 6 after having inserted it it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. After completing any ending except Ending 1, players will unlock a hidden moon called End . This moon is not a traditional moon and instead serves as the credits for Wesley's Moons. This moon can also be used to farm knives, shotguns, and shovels.
plain.p-etern: Etern was home to a scientific lab where biological experiments took place. Many new lifeforms were created here among which are the famous Baboon Hawks. In more recent times they have been working on "Project Nutcracker" as instructed. Rumors are that they used human subjects for emotional manipulation using certain toy masks. POPULATION: Transformed. CONDITIONS: Warm, Dry sandy terrain, supports plant life such as cactaceae and rarely polypodiophyta. FAUNA: A thriving ecosystem, creatures support agressive behaviour. Etern is a deserted moon. It has polypodiophyta scattered around the moon with cactaceae spread about. Etern has lots of steep hills that you can't walk up. After the bomb goes off at 5pm the place turns into a barren wasteland where the cactaceae are turned into molten rock from the explosion with heavy amounts of fog and dust from the explosion making it hard to see. Etern can experience Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default. On Etern you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside. Etern's exterior has a siren that will go off at 05:00pm outside a fence, which can also be heard while inside the interior. At 06:00pm the siren will stop and a bomb will be dropped. This bomb doesn't do any damage regardless of proximity, but makes everything foggy outside and hard to see. By around 10:00pm the dust will settle. Etern's interior plays unique ambient sounds, primarily to trick the player into thinking there is danger. For example, a Nutcracker can be heard scanning an area in the distance as well as the distant spring of a Coil-Head as if it had been spotted. Etern's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, walk straight forward from the front of the ship and it'll be slightly to the right in some plants and grass. This mysterious object is a Brooding seed that can found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah . Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet." This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, and visually alters the interior. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Filitrios , Fission-C , Gloom , and Utril , in which case the changes become permanent on that save file. Logging "Geoffrey's log 4" found on the exterior of Junic . Alternatively, inserting the Etern videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Calist , Fission-C , Oldred , Polarus , or Trite into the projector in Galetry . Dune: Craft a "Blank floppy disc" on Galetry , insert it into the Floppy Disc Machine on Etern's exterior, and log "Dune floppy disc". Glace: Log "Geoffrey's log 3" found on the exterior. Gratar: Gratar videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior. Oldred: Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior. Geoffrey's log 3 - continues the reversed storyline of Agent Geoffrey, unlocking Glace when logged. He comments on the state of the war, his family, the vanishing of Cosmocos , and the development of some kind of mind control technology using Cosmic Growth. Text ⁠ It’s been over one hundred and twenty days since my meeting on Polarus and the devastating Catalyst of this Grand War we now find ourselves in. As we had foreseen, the military of Titan was not pleased with the initial attack and launched a counter attack within the same week. It only escalated from there.. However, I’m pleased to report that my family, my wife, and my children have all safely made it to Trite, as promised.. I do hope the trip wasn’t as bad as mine have been. They were moved in secrecy for their own protection. So unfortunately I am unable to contact them.. At least that’s what I was told when I tried my hardest to do so. Maybe it’s for the better. I have only a few more missions to complete before I can visit my family again. Speaking of which, The teams we send out to Cosmocos have vanished.. And.. So has the entire moon. It vanished from the radars entirely. Which seems impossible and yet is true. This happened only days after they found something.. incredible that would’ve been the key to our victory. All that returned was a confused and mad Commander Cunningham who supposedly tried to sabotage the operations. And a large amount of so-called “Cosmic Growth”. Anyways, I have been tasked to guide a group of scientists here with the creation of manipulative weapons using the aforementioned Cosmic Growth. They’ll grow into the brain of whoever it will be applied to and we’ll supposedly have full control over them. Think of it as a mind controlling parasite. It will hopefully aid us in this war. Then once that’s done I will vanish in the night for my next task. Agent G- Signing off. Tape Player Logs & Protocol Wipeout Additionally, Tape player protocol wipeout and Tape player logs can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They tell the rest of the story of the scientist that created G.A.R.Y., the AI sold to the company on Gratar . They talk about the installation of a nuke on Etern, a former project that created Baboon Hawks, a new project for the creation of Nutcrackers, and the aforementioned manipulative weapons resulting in the creation of Masked. The scientist died to a Nutcracker via gunshot. Protocol Wipeout Text ⁠ Year 154, day 12. Today is a scary day. Protocol wipeout was approved and the nuclear bomb will be installed tomorrow. Knowing where it came from I no longer feel quite as safe here. I can only imagine what could go wrong. Worse. How it could ruin years of research and experimentation! In case you don't know.. Protocol wipeout is only called during.. events of disaster. Destroying. Everything. As much as I am facinated with the craft, I refuse to let it destroy all we've done. Perhaps I could modify some of its components. We'll see. Now that project hawk is complete, we have received plans for new machines that will be used in the Grand War that just broke out. It will be called, Project Nutcracker. I'm excited. Me out. Tape Player Log 1 / Scientist Log 1 Text ⁠ Year 154, day 136. Business as usual. Project nutcracker is well on the way. These droids are getting more advanced by the day. Especially since Geoffrey joined us a week ago. Great stuff. Me out. Tape Player Log 2 / Scientist Log 2 Text ⁠ Year 154, day 139. Uhh giants are still as prevalent as allways. Uh. We started to experiment with emotional manipulation alongside project nutcracker. We just need the proper items to uh bind it to. Me out. Tape Player Log 3 / Scientist Log 3 Text ⁠ Year 154, day 146. We used masks.. Big mistake. They seem to get stuck to their wearers.. uh.. No other side effects have been noted. I haven't seen it myself but I've heard project nutcracker was a succes! It sounds like they're actually alive! uh.. We also noticed that Geoffrey went missing recently. We are looking into that. Me out. Tape Player Log 4 / Scientist Log 4 Text ⁠ Year 154, day 15.. something. I am on the run. Those masks.. took them. They're not them anymore. They took my team! Converted half of them! The nutcrackers are not droids like I thought. I.. I saw one of them. It shot me.. right in the chest before I got here. I'm bleeding out. I think the nutcrackers.. They're my coworkers.. Or what's left of them. I think those masked men.. I think they.. *Gunshot* Etern Videotape If players find the Etern videotape randomly as scrap within the interiors of other moons and insert it into the projector in Galetry , the story of Captain Commander Cunningham continues. Confusingly, Etern is recorded as "Tape 3" while Atlantica is recorded as "Tape 2" by Cunningham. On the other hand, Cunningham's travel log 2 explicitly states that Cunningham routed to Atlantica after visiting Etern. Either way, this chronologically happened some time between Cunningham routing to Infernis and Cunningham routing to Acidir . This videotape can be found on Calist , Fission-C , Oldred , Trite and Polarus . Text ⁠ Tape 3, Etern. This is Captain Cunningham. I have not been able to record much here and we will be leaving as soon as possible. Our trip to Etern has been an absolute disaster. I’ve seen more nutcrackers searching for us than there are grains of sand in this desert. We’ve lost many and I’m not keen on losing any more of us. Etern gets an S+. I highly discourage anyone from going here. Cunningham, signing off. > Trivia Before "Obscurity" video material on Etern videotape was different: > Gallery Unfinished Section This section seems unfinished. plain.p-expanded-facility: The main entrance of the Expanded Facility. The Expanded Facility is a variation of the Facility , also referred to as Factory, interior that adds many extra tiles and some minor features. It most commonly spawns on ResearcherxB and Release . The latter has a unique trial there instead of a Secondary Objective . Nail Machine - A machine that generates in a large Wire Room typically close by the Main Entrance. There are several server racks in the room and two Fuses on a stool next to the machine. This machine holds the reward for completing a Secondary Objective . Wire Room - A large or small room with various wires on the roof and wall and a metal floor. Additional Server Rooms - A handful of other rooms with severs now generate. One has a window that looks into it and another has a staircase. Large Storage - A large room with a few shelving units inside and big boxes inside. Backup Power - A small room with shelving units and a sign that reads "BACKUP POWER". Square Catwalk - Catwalks connecting to each other in a room to form a square. Rotating Platform - Scrap can be placed on small platforms that rotate by pushing a red button. This is primarily useful for transporting scrap past an Electrical Gate . Electrical Gate - Primarily spawns in front of small storage rooms with a warning sign that reads "DO NOT CROSS WITH MECHANICAL PARTS". Holding "mechanical parts" in the player's hand and attempting to pass through this gate deals 99 damage to the player. "Mechanical parts" are any scrap tagged as lethal_company:metal (Cash registers, Clown horns, Big bolts, etc.) and the Machine parts scrap. The Rotating Platform can be used to safely transport scrap past the gate, but the player can also just drop the scrap near the gate, walk to the other side, and safely grab it. The Nail Machine with the Fuses next to it. One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn after twisting the dial on the Nail Machine . Players must bring and insert a Fuse into two panels found in the interior. Once inserted, players can interact with the dial and cause a light to start sequentially going from top to bottom on the side. Players must pull the crank on the right at the same time that light is over the yellow circle three times, with the yellow circle potentially changing positions and the light speeding up or slowing down to throw players off. There is also a delay between the light going from the bottom back to the top circle. Once both panels have successfully turned on, players can return to the Nail Machine and twist the dial for their reward. Players must bring and insert a Fuse into two panels of switches found in the interior. Once inserted, players must flick all the switches in a specific but random order. Flicking the switches in the incorrect order will cause all switches to reset. If successful, a sound effect will play and the panel can no longer be interacted with. Once both panels are activated, players can return to the Nail Machine and twist the dial for their reward. Players must bring and insert both Fuses into a panel hooked up to a machine with several valves that generates in a Large Storage room. Typically, this room is either near the main entrance or connected to the large open room. After activation, players can simply do nothing and the pressure will stabilize after about 180 seconds. However, players can turn the valves on the machine that are releasing steam to stabilize the pressure faster. Once stabilized, all the valves will turn and a sound effect will play. Players can now return to the Nail Machine and twist the dial for their reward. plain.p-expanded-mineshaft: The main entrance of the Expanded Mineshaft. The Expanded Mineshaft is a variation of the Mineshaft that is similar in gameplay but is structurally different. It also adds several extra tiles. It commonly spawns on Chasm , Core , Dreck , Infernis , and Lecaro . It most commonly spawns on Descent and features a unique trial there instead of a Secondary Objective . Locked Storage - A room with several lockers, benches, and hangers behind a special locked door. Typically spawns close to the main entrance and requires completing a Secondary Objective to open. Conveyor Belt - A room with a conveyor belt that typically spawns near the main entrance. Pressure Management - A room with many pipes inside of it. Cave-In - Some hallways have dead ends as a result of a cave-in. Coal Storage - A room with many containers of coal. Minecart Storage - An area with many minecarts placed on the tracks. Furnace - A room with a furnace in it and coal nearby. Two furnaces can also spawn across from each other in hallways. Lifts - Areas with smaller lifts likely used for transporting materials and supplies up and down. Falling to the bottom kills the player. Chasm - A broken pathway above a large chasm that must be jumped over. Falling to the bottom kills the player. Spider Cave - A pathway in the caves leading to a pit with several webs, eggs, and a Bunker Spider on the other side. This room always generates but is only accessible through normal means if the Dissolve the Webs objective is generated. The Locked Storage door with the Gas tank for the Fuel the Generator objective next to it. One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that spawns in the Locked Storage room. Players must find two panels of switches in the main area of the mineshaft. Players must flick up all the switches that have a wire connected to a red light and flick down all other switches. A sound effect will play and the panel can no longer be interacted with if successful. After both panels are turned on, a sound effect will be heard and players can return to and open the Locked Storage for their reward. If a Gas tank spawns next to the Locked Storage door, players must bring it to a yellow generator with its light on somewhere in the caves. Players must pour the gas into the funnel on the machine connected to the generator. After the gas has been poured, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the Locked Storage for their reward. If webs are above or around the Locked Storage door, players must find the now accessible Spider Cave in the caves. Players must cross the pit to reach the other side with the Bunker Spider, several webs, and several eggs. A web on a pipe that periodically sparks can be interacted with to remove it at the end of the room. If successful, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the Locked Storage for their reward. plain.p-extort: Extort was primarily exploited for its resources as it was rich in nature, oil and various metals. Later on it became a popular spot for travel. Ownership was transferred to the Trite Control Corporation. POPULATION: Abandoned CONDITIONS: Cold, snowy terrain. Suffers from frequent hurricanes. FAUNA: Dominated by a few species. Unfinished Section This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section. Extort can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default. This moon features a trial that generates on the exterior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth an average of ▮378. The specific rewards are several "Small diamond" and one "Grind the deluded ticket" scrap. To complete this trial: Find the shed with an employee strapped to a table and hooked up to a machine. Go straight and slightly right from the back of the ship past the first hill until you reach a second hill. The shed is at the bottom. This is also where one of the fire exits is. To the right of the machine will be three gas canisters and the names of three locations. Take a gas canister to any of these locations. There is a map on the wall in the shed to use as a guide. When you reach a location, fuel the generator near the grinder the employee is trapped in with the gas canister. Wait for the employee to be grinded and grab the "Gore bucket" that gets filled. Return to the shed and insert the gore into the machine the employee is hooked up to. Repeat steps 2-4 two more times. There is a hole in the back of the shed to crouch through that leads to a submerged building. Retrieve a blue key that spawns in a random location inside. Jumping prevents drowning. Return to the shed, press the red button to the left of the employee, and insert the blue key into the key slot to the right of the map as prompted. The rewards will spawn in front of the grinder shortly afterward. Inserting the "Grind the deluded" videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Descent into the projector in Galetry . plain.p-facto: A new curious factory has emerged in Facto… and now rumors of a comfy shoe that makes hunting monsters easier are spreading. Can you survive the Crocs mission? POPULATION: Abandoned CONDITIONS: Dry. dusty, many industrial artifacts. FAUNA: Dominated by a few Crocs-wearing species. Owned by Crocs(tm) Facto is an abandoned industrial moon featuring rough landscape, dead soil, several bushes, dead trees, lying rocks, telecommunications poles and factory buildings that contain Crocs shoes. Upon exiting the ship, to right and left will be telecommunications poles and especially large one to the left. When you go left those poles will lead you close to one of the fire exits. Leading straight out of the ship and going behind that one little hill in front of the ship will lead you close enough to the main entrance to spot it. To access the second and last fire exit on this moon, you need to go a little bit right from that small hill and then you should be able to find it. Facto supports Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Earthquake, Forsaken, Hallowed, and Hurricane weather by default. On this moon you can find unique scrap such as crocs shoes . For example: gold croc, glitter croc, box of crocs, time croc, etc. Vanilla scrap can also be found, like: egg beater, cookie mold pan, V-type engine, etc. Except finding crocs shoes , you can also encounter enemies wearing those . Entities like earth leviathan or hygrodere do not have them for obvious reasons. All enemies on this moon are the same as Vanilla ones. Crocs shoes on their feet are just a cosmetic addition. Inserting Facto videotape to videotape player on Galetry. This videotape that can be found on Polarus , Filitrios , Empra , Trite and in Gift Shop on Galetry . This moon does not unlock any other moon. NOTE: Maneater plushie, Silent package and Webley will be able to spawn only if you downloaded Wesley's Moons. plain.p-faith: A moon housed by a friendly religious group. They care for nature. It is their purpose. It is their believe. But don't be mislead by the beauty of this moon. POPULATION: Few CONDITIONS: Half days, warm, fields of invasive flower species. FAUNA: Dominated by Earth Leviathans. Unfinished Section This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section. Faith is covered with flora. The landscape is also littered with holes due to the Earth Leviathan activity. Half-days occur on Faith, meaning it gets very dark very quickly. Faith can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default. On Faith you can hear three ambiences: Inside ambience (that plays inside facility), day ambience (that plays during the day) and night ambience (Which plays during night). Faith's exterior has various interactable levers on stone shrines. Pulling the lever will cause the light to change color and a sound effect to be heard. The easiest way to reach any of them is to follow the dirt pathway and there are six in total. Once all six levers have been pulled, a hidden area will open in a giant rock that is behind and to the far right of the ship (near the Cosmocos shrine). Inside will be the scrap "My task 5" as well as an interactable mysterious object . If players interact with this object, the inside of the rock will change and an Assimilated Growth will immediately spawn in the interior when landing on Faith in the future. This persists until the player is fired unless the Brooding seeds from Berunah are placed on the other altars found on the exteriors of Etern , Filitrios , Fission-C , Gloom , and Utril . Once every seed has been placed, the object will move onto the altar on its own if players did not move it already and all these changes become permanent on that save file. Log "My task 4" that has at least one guaranteed spawn as scrap within the interior of Core . Berunah: Log "My task 5" found in the Secret Passage on the exterior. Hyve: A breakable hive can spawn near the Faith shrine and big rock south of the ship on the exterior, spawning the Hyve videotape when broken. Image & Text ⁠ Atlantica The defender of sorrowed seas Her tears flow with the waves Her waves flow through the citadels Her sadness tasting until the end of time Unable to protect her people and their homes Watching them fall time and time again Powerless to prevent This presence signifies grief, one to be comforted Image & Text ⁠ Cosmocos Shaper of celestial beauty From glittering crystals to bioluminescent growth A creature with hands that shape the stars One who creates with uniquentess unfound A mind full of wonder He ponders in silence, dreams and imagines This presence signifies creativity, one to be inspired by Image & Text ⁠ Faith Keeper of peace There where the grass grows the tallest The flowers spread the widest She guides the restless toward forgiveness Predators to pause and grey to trust. Wherever she roams, the world breathes of ease The presence signifies union, a lesson to remember Image & Text ⁠ Etern Walker of wild sands Between the hills of sand he walks Observing the horizon Guarding his path from those who dare intrude A quiet soul who kept a promise None others shall walk his way to home The presence signifies responsibility one to be mindful Image & Text ⁠ Junic Beast of the jungles The woods are dark And their intents darker There roams a beast a demon a creature of ill will He watches the people closely Compells them to do wretched things The presence signifies evil, one to be fearful of Image & Text ⁠ Polarus Survivor of the cold The winds shriek with Frost and snow Lakes of ice, death lays beneath Conditions too harsh for one to stay But an old man knows when to wait He knows not to meddle with nature But to embrance its ways The presence signifies wisdom, one to look up to Image & Text ⁠ Many years ago in a time long passed. A young man stood between the flowers in a ray of moonlight. Observing the stars, taking in the beauty that is the universe. He did this every night. And every time it was breathtaking. But on one fateful night it was different. He saw a bright light in the sky. A comet?, A creature? no, something more. He described it as a soul or a presence.. And it spoke. There between the flowers he listened to this voice from deep space. It sounded powerful, but vague. A message he couldn't understand. Yet he was inspired. He had to hear this again. He had to tell everyone he knew. This was something special. Image & Text ⁠ And every night he went back to that spot. Hoping to see that light again. But he didn't. For days he waited, hoping. And it wasn't until the seventh day when he heard it again. He saw it in the sky. He was certain it was real. The message was equally vague. Now he was determined. He explained it to his friends. It took a lot of convincing to get them to join him for one night. And that night it was there. They all saw it. Moving across the sky. Yet only he was able to hear it. But they believed him. They weren't sure what to make of it. They all sat there, pondering, wondering. What or... who is this? Image & Text ⁠ They brought this newfound knowledge to the village. They told everyone. While of course there were a lot of sceptics, there were few who had seen this light before when they were young. It had never spoken to them however. Maybe it wasn't a creature. Or something akin to that. Maybe it was the essence of their moon. Like a spirit, a presence as they described it. It only made sense... And so they wished to see it again. To hopefully hear it speak, again. They built shrines to please this presence. And even those of others. They started giving them names, bodies, appearences, identities. They would bring gifts to please them. They would care for nature. The well being of their moon. Hoping to hear it again. ... They never did, but they kept trying. Image & Text ⁠ I have made it to faith but my health has rapidly declined. I can barely walk. It's there, I feel it sitting in my chest... Growing... This tumor. I escaped the war.. I SURVIVED And this is how the universe rewards me? Life is suffering. Always has been, from the moment I was created. One month after being born I was already on the battlefield. Posessing memories of someone I'm not. They didn't even give me a name. I was a number. A duplicate of someone else. ... My body is crumbling, I should get going. And when I'm done. All my problems will go away. My salvation lies on Berunah. Main entrance Faith complete darkness (shorter days)

plain.p-fractured-complex: The main entrance of the Fractured Complex The Fractured Complex is a factory-like interior with various machinery and conveyor belts. It most commonly spawns on Empra . Secure Door - A large security door that spawns near the main entrance. This door can be opened by interacting with the lever next to it after completing a Secondary Objective . Break Room - A room that can typically spawn near the main entrance that has lockers, cabinets, a refrigerator, etc. Scrap can spawn in this room and typically in the larger cabinet. Server Room - A room with server racks, cabinets, and lockers. Scrap can spawn in this room, especially in the cabinets. Machinery Rooms - Multiple different rooms with varying machinery in them. Scrap can spawn in in these rooms. Long Conveyor Belt - A larger room with staircases and a long conveyor belt(s). Scrap frequently spawns in this room. Security Room - A security office with several desks and monitors with a narrow hallway. This room is mostly for the Facility Security objective. Catwalks - Long, winding catwalks with numerous branching paths and doors. Scrap can spawn on small platforms near the railings or frequently in a part of this area that has a staircase and multiple cabinets. Apparatus - A regular apparatus that is not guaranteed to spawn. If it does spawn, it will either be in its own room or in a large square area of the Catwalks . Sliding Doors - Doors players can open and shut by interacting with the lever next to them. They can randomly slam shut when players approach them or walk through them and will open on their own after some time. The Secure Door that holds the reward. One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn past the Secure Door . Players must find two sets of valves in the interior. A monitor displays the current pressure while a notice on the wall displays the target pressure. Players must add to or subtract from the current pressure by turning the valves left or right to reach the target pressure. Each valve can only be turned in a direction once before having to be turned the other way to return to its starting position. For example, if a player turns a valve to add 10, they can only turn the valve the other way to subtract 10 before being able to turn the valve to add 10 again. A sound effect will play after the target pressure is reached and the valves can not be interacted with anymore. Once both sets of valves reach their target pressure, a sound effect will play and players can return to the Secure Door to get their reward. Players must find two panels on the wall that have a 3x3 grid of buttons on it in the interior. Pressing one button will press all adjacent buttons and players must turn all the buttons green to turn on the power. A sound effect will play if players are successful and the panel can no longer be interacted with. Once both panels have had all their buttons turned green, another sound effect will play and players can return to the Secure Door to get their reward. Players must find their way to the Security Room . There are six live wires electrifying the floor and blocking the walkway, rapidly dealing 15 damage per hit to players. Players must get close enough to each wire to see the name tag on them or color of them and then return to a panel of 18 wires at the start of the room to cut that matching wire. Cutting a wrong wire will deal 90 damage to the player. Once all six live wires have been cut, players can safely walk to the end of the room and press a button. A sound effect will play and players can return to the Secure Door to get their reward. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. Facility Power is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier while Facility Pressure and Facility Security are considered Medium difficulty and have a 1.15x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section. A sideview of The Compactor. The Compactor can randomly spawn within the interior. It spawns 16 Silver sheets inside of it that are conductive, weigh 26lbs, and range from ▮20 to ▮107 each. As soon as a player enters The Compactor , its roof will begin to shut and a panel will be lowered to reveal five grids of buttons. Pressing one button will press all adjacent buttons in that grid. Players must turn all the buttons green to open the exit door. Gears on the wall will have a Silver sheet already stuck in them. This sheet will break after roughly 14 seconds as soon as players drop in, causing The Compactor to begin advancing forward. Players must insert another Silver sheet into the gears to halt its advance for roughly another 24 seconds before that sheet breaks too. Players must repeatedly sacrifice Silver sheets to stall The Compactor while solving the grid puzzles to open the exit door and escape before it crushes them. It is recommended that players quickly scan for lower value sheets and either hold them in their inventory or place them near the gears to pick up and insert as needed. It is also recommended to move Silver sheets closer to the exit, as they can not be collected through normal means once The Compactor moves over top of them. Any Silver sheets that players can successfully get out of The Compactor is their reward for the event. This can range anywhere from ▮0 to ▮1752 depending on both how lucky and skillful players are. The average total for all 16 Silver sheets spawned is ▮1016. The Break Room. The Server Room. A room with machinery in it. The large room with the long conveyor belt. The Security Room. The Catwalks. plain.p-galetry: Galetry is A peaceful gallery resting between the mountain tops. Eager to collect your scrap and deliver it to the company building. POPULATION: Abandoned. CONDITIONS: Warm, hilly terrain, supports diverse plantlife. FAUNA: A healthy ecosystem, fauna rarely exhibits dangerous behaviour. Galetry is a forested and hilly moon. Trees, tall grass, and flowers cover the terrain and a waterfall can be seen behind the ship falling into a small river. The time of day is randomly selected between morning, noon, evening, and rarely night when players land on the moon. The most prominent feature on Galetry is the large building directly behind the ship, which plays music inside. It houses busts of Hoarding Bugs and a giant art museum of pictures depicting both custom content from Wesley's Moons and vanilla Lethal Company areas, such as Experimentation and Offense . Two smaller buildings can be found to the left and right of the ship respectively, the left being the Fire Exit and the right being the Gift Shop. Immediately left upon entering will be a Log translator for players to log Loggable Items . Additionally, a Videotape player can be found by going left upon entering the building, climbing a ladder on the right-hand side, and climbing the stairs to the right. Videotapes can be inserted into here for players to watch and unlock new moons. A desk can be found on the right side of the building where players can sell their scrap. Immediately to the right upon entering the building, players can also place items on a counter and press a button to transfer them over to the desk to make transportation of large amounts of scrap easier. A bust of a Hoarding Bug with a flashlight pointing to another bust can be found on the left side of the building. Interacting with the bust the flashlight is pointing at will cause the stairs to move and reveal a hidden backstage area. Butch, a passive and invulnerable Butler, will appear and start cleaning when players walk through. At the end of the hallway is a sealed door, The great mystery log, and a large apparatus sticking out on the left side. Interacting with this apparatus will turn the lights on. Players can leave this area by backtracking, interacting with a Hoarding Bug bust, and waiting for the stairs to move again. Additionally, players will find slots to insert three more special apparatus on either side of the sealed door: The Cosmic apparatus , Royal apparatus , and Bloody apparatus . These can be found on Cosmocos , Calist , and Demetrica respectively. Inserting an apparatus will be saved until the player is fired, but inserting all three apparatus will permanently be saved on the save file. Once all three are inserted, the door will open to reveal the Hyx videotape and the Dread log. Scattered around the museum are a few tapes. There is one for Motra , Infernis , Asteroid-13 , and a special tape labeled "???" A fire exit can be found to the left after exiting the ship. Inside will be a door to the left that requires a Fabricated key to open, the Intruder log, and a blocked entrance. A Fabricated key can be crafted on Gratar for one Steel, two Copper wiring, and one Rubber. After opening the door, a fabrication machine similar to the one on Gratar can be found where players can craft Blank floppy discs instead of Untampered operating panels . Players can also still craft Triangulation devices , Double barrel shotguns , Shotgun shells , Adrenaline-stims , Health-stims , Pulatrum spore emitters , Boomboxes , Advanced flashlights , Fog reducers , Radar boosters , Action figures , Weed killer , De-weed , Pesticide sprinklers , Fabricated keys , and Single-barrel shotguns on Galetry . Any Ingredient Items deposited into either machine will be shared between them and resources will save even after players are fired. Note that there is a conversion rate for ingredients to resources (e.g., 1 Steel ingot equals 3 Steel) and these can be found in the Ingredient Items section mentioned above. Dread can be found in the room past the secure door. Text ⁠ I cannot say I am much of a writer, I beg of you, don’t have grave expectations. As for any story it would be good to know who’s behind the pencil. Or keyboard in this instance. To introduce myself, my name is Zellenah. Born on Haltar under the family name Cross. For those who are unaware, Haltar is likely one of the wealthiest moons still remaining in our region. First, an agreement. Then the golden flame. Foolish to have gotten involved. Our father couldn’t keep the political talk to himself so I’ve become rather educated on the conflict. I feel I am already losing the path. Where was I? Ah yes. For the greater part of my life I have spent mindlessly staring at golden halls and sipping the most elegant vintages while relatives endlessly discuss their fortunes with a devotion I could not understand. We’ve always gone on the same trips and visited the same fountains. I couldn’t convey how often I’ve seen the gemstone waters. You could say I’ve always had more of an explorative trait. The predictability of it all became rather stifling. The people are kind, but perhaps a touch soulless. All they conversed about was their wealth and what grandiose places they visited. I found it to be rather dull. Terribly underwhelming. I fear the normality of it all has greatly impacted my joy of what were seemingly magnificent things. I found myself unwilling to accept such predictability so I left for a few trips outside of our usual experiences. A majority of the places I went to were fresh, unique. Often whelming as I had witnessed the same before but on a grander scale. Then, during one of these visits there were these magnetized pebbles. Not too extraordinary I believe we have all seen magnets before. But these pebbles, when they touched they would brighten up. Not only brighten up, they would share a light that traveled between them. Now that was lovely. I had never seen that before. Truly magnificent. I still have them somewhere I am quite certain. Perhaps in one of my drawers with the crystals which pacifies insects with a soft drone, another magical find. Either way I put on a glove and took a hand full of them back to the manor. From then on all I ever wanted was to collect more of these interesting objects. Indeed I did. I went on many trips following this initial find. I had gathered plentiful mistiques. It had gotten to a point where they were turning my manors into a dreadful mess. There was a terrible need for a place to put these things. And that’s when I came with the idea of the gallery. A gallery of uniquities. I wouldn’t want it to be back on Haltar, you could display something magnificent and they wouldn’t even lift their glasses. This place looks delightful and happens to be right in the center of everything. Nearly too good to be true. So I acquired this small moon and began planning out the gallery. A few months pass and now we are here. I appreciate your reading. I find it incredibly relaxing to write. Perhaps I might write some more in the future. Text ⁠ I desire to write again following today's frightful ordeal. It was in the early morning when the trouble began. I had woken up from an annoyingly repetitive beeping coming from my computer. And so I had a gaze at what happened to be a message. It was deeply unsettling. It read as follows: “The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”. Of course I took this sudden message very dear. It had appeared to be rather important though a bit distasteful. So as with any message of seemingly grave importance like this I had informed them, in terms perhaps less diplomatic than advisable, that I had no interest in their proposal. Not much time had passed and I heard this charming jingle of an elevator of sorts followed by an explosion. Immediately I put on my gloves and armed myself with an antique blade in hopes it would scare away whoever had impolitely seared my front yard. Or at the very least offer me the confidence to confront them. To my surprise there was nobody there. Only the wind, a dull quietness and a pod with a big gap presumably from the explosion. Then to my surprise, a dreadful swarm of hornets attacked me. I ran away as fast as I could and locked myself in my bed chamber. Then I remembered those droning crystals. Unsure where I had left them I began searching. It had taken me a fair moment but in the end I discovered them to be in a small box in one of my closets. I took out a few and slowly opened the door. Nothing in the hallway. Quite curious. I slowly made my way along the gallery towards the entrance, not a hornet in sight. Then to my surprise there was a bulging man standing in the grass. He quietly gazed at me. To my knowledge I was alone, there hadn’t been any visitors in days. I yelled out to him. No response. Frightening. I took a step back. Then he seemed to search for something in his tailor coat. Before long he ran at me holding a shimmering knife. Having neither a plan or any courage in that moment I instinctively held out the small bag of crystals between us. To my surprise this bloated man seemed enamored by them. Staring soullessly into the bag. Only then it dawned on me, this was not an ordinary man at all, but a deteriorating arrangement of skin and cloth piloted by these hornets. The dreadful smell only confirmed that. Terrifying discovery yet I must admit in a way quite divine. I had led him to the back room as he followed the bag of crystals. As I had no proper placement for this ominous gentleman, I elected to leave him where he was. I don’t think he minds that much. Finally I return to my computer only to find it beeping once more. A new message. “You have received your first and only warning, The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.” I was left with a choice and perhaps in an act of fear I agreed. As long as I help their workers ship the things they found to Gordion without interrupting their work, I should be left alone. I’m hopeful. Text ⁠ There has been a fair passage of time between now and the previous time I have written. I had not expected this arrangement would prove so demanding. It feels as though every few days a new ship arrives at my door, not to be enamored by the mystiques of my gallery but rather to dispose of the debris they have gathered. I have attempted to inquire about their work yet they seem either hesitant to explain or convey that they know as much as I do. Either way, I have made the wise decision to automate the process of exporting these worthless pieces to Gordion. I cannot imagine taking care of such matters personally without leaving me exhausted. There has however been one thing I became aware of regarding this mysterious company. They do not take kindly to their employees and demand them work an absurd amount where failure appears to be met with termination in the quite literal sense. I have always been aware of the cruelty within this region from the tales but I had never imagined it to be this terrible. Not until I met this gentleman of the name Marcus Brad. I wouldn't say it was the most pleasant of encounters. This company ship had landed and were doing their own usual business. I on the other hand was altering some of the displays, not quite paying the attention to my surroundings as I likely should have. Upon turning, I discovered an armed stranger silently standing a few paces behind me, which in honesty I found considerably less pleasant than the display I had been arranging moments earlier. It was quite alarming even and my response was rather lacking. He demanded that I help him with his harrowing situation which, at the time, I wasn’t aware of how bad it was. His suit appeared worn, bloodied with a scorch mark covering the left side of his helmet. An intimidating figure. I exclaimed I wouldn’t know how and even if I did there would be a chance this mysterious company would return with evil intent. He appeared serious, slightly frustrated even. Still pointing the weapon in my direction I attempted to politely ask for his name and how I could be of service. “My name is Marcus.”, he replied. “I have survived this company for at least five weeks now. You wouldn’t believe what they put us through. You need to help me escape them. Sooner or later they will try to kill me again.”. This ominous response left me curious and so I tried to inquire what exactly he meant with, they will try to kill him again. He replied: “We have a quota we have to meet every few days. It keeps getting higher
plain.p-gilded-jester: The Gilded Jester is a hostile entity and variant of the Jester added by Wesley's Ememy Variants . It is a golden jack-in-the-box with two legs, an arm, and an image of a skull on its center. When it pops open, a golden skull connected to several cables comes out of the box. Similar to the Jester, the Gilded Jester will roam around the interior until it spots a player. It will then follow that player before beginning to crank itself. After it finishes cranking, the box will pop open and the Gilded Jester will attempt to chase and instantly kill the closest player on contact. It will get faster the longer it chases players, but its speed will reset after it kills an employee or it is stunned. The Gilded Jester will only close its box and begin roaming again once all players have left the interior. The Gilded Jester has a much faster roaming and following speed and a much longer countdown before it begins cranking compared to the Jester. However, its cranking duration is significantly shorter. It has a countdown of 80 to 100 seconds before it starts cranking and a cranking duration of 10 to 15 seconds. The Gilded Jester has a 45.35% chance to spawn in the interior of Empra , typically spawning near the start of the day due to the interior spawn curve. The entry for the Gilded Jester is the same as the Jester. Jester ⁠ JESTER Sigurd's danger level: 90% Get out o fthere before it goes APE!! Text ⁠ I did not expect this meeting to go the way it did. While I tried to educate the Emperor on the matters back at the Grand Capitol. he seemed uninterested and looked at me with a rather lifeless expression. I explained how the Council of Rule is very adamant about not allowing any bioweapons to be used or studied.. But then he told me.. He wanted me to.. The Triton Military will decimate the Grand Capitol as well as the moon it sits on. This will be.. soon, on the day of the final conference. Judgement day. And he wanted me to give the order. This will be the catalyst of a region wide war. Yet I did as he asked. I gave the order. In the name of the Emperor. This means I will not be returning home and I was promised that my family will be moved to Trite to keep them safe from what’s about to come. I hope to see them soon. Soon I will be off to 61-March where I will prepare 3 groups of scientists to set course for the mysterious moon of 42-Cosmocos in hopes of finding something to aid us in the upcoming war against the dominions who will oppose the Triton Military and the Emperor. This will not be pleasant. But I am ready. Agent G- Signing off.

Gloom environment Gloom can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default. On Gloom you can hear ambience that plays outside. The player's clock is hidden while on Gloom. However, time progresses at its normal speed. Gloom's exterior and interior has a foggy-like effect that reduces visibility. The interior fog can increase or decrease in intensity throughout the day. In the cave where the main entrance can be found, a map displays the location of all cave entrances and has a X on it. This X is a detonator that is located next to one of cabins (fire exits) on the exterior. The easiest way to reach it is to walk almost directly southwest from the ship and then follow the lanterns to the detonator. Pushing this detonator causes two fire exits, which are the left most and right most cave entrances on the map respectively, to become accessible from the exterior. However, pushing this detonator also causes a cave-in that renders the main entrance and the cave it's in to be inaccessible from the exterior. Gloom's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, follow the pathway behind the ship and walk along the edge of the water, turn left near the big tree and walk towards a lantern, turn right and walk to the second lantern, and walk a little straight and turn left past the second lantern. This mysterious object is a Brooding seed that can be found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah . Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet". This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the Assimilated Growth to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Etern , Filitrios , Fission-C , and Utril , in which case the changes become permanent on that save file. plain.p-gold-disturbed-masked: The Gold Disturbed Masked is a hostile entity and variant of the Masked added by Wesley's Ememy Variants . It is an employee with a Gold disturbed mask attached to their face. Identical to a regular Masked, the Gold Disturbed Masked will roam around in search of players. It looks similar to a normal player on the radar but will often be seen spinning around. It will look around, sprint, and stop sprinting randomly. If no player is within the interior, it will try to reach the main entrance and exit onto the exterior and vice versa. It will also make its way to the ship after some time to hide and wait for players to return to ambush them. If a Gold Disturbed Masked spots a player, it will pause before beginning to chase them. If a player comes into contact with it, they'll be grabbed and the Gold Disturbed Masked will try to convert them. This can be interrupted if the Gold Disturbed Masked is hit. Otherwise, the player will die, their body and any scrap they were holding can not be recovered, and a second Gold Disturbed Masked will spawn. An initial Gold Disturbed Masked will only be spawned if a player wears and randomly gets possessed by the Gold disturbed scrap that is a potential Secondary Objective Reward from the Toy Store . plain.p-grand-armory: The main entrance of the Grand Armory. The Grand Armory is a large arsenal that most commonly spawns on Selector . The Grand Armory is quite spacious, having large open rooms and five floors with stairs and elevators connecting them. The main entrance is always accompanied by two lamps on either side of the door. Missile Container - A platform that spawns close to the main entrance with a missile in a container. This container can be opened after completing a Secondary Objective . Server Rooms - Enclosed rooms with a light on top of them, often containing lockers and lots of scrap. These rooms have a lever that can be turned off to shut down the power to that room, making the light on top green instead of yellow. This can be used as a helpful indicator that a room has already been looted. Shipping Containers - Some shipping container doors can be opened. These containers are typically on the ground floor. Cold Storage - A cold storage room where scrap can spawn. Can connect to either a dead end with a possible Lurker at the end of it or can connect to The Exterminator event. Liquid Area - A large portion of the armory that has various platforms connected over liquid. A larger Server Room typically spawns in this area. Charging Station - A room similar to a Server Room but with a powered off apparatus outside of it and a charge station inside of it. Typically spawns in the Liquid Area . Toxic Apparatus - A green apparatus that typically spawns on a grated platform, typically in the Liquid Area . It is worth ▮280, is two-handed, and weighs 31lbs. Taking the apparatus will trigger a Lockdown . Elevator - An elevator near the main entrance can be used to go between different floors with the push of a button. Breaker Box - When turning off multiple switches on the breaker box, the lights will turn red and begin to play alarm sound. This primarily makes it easier to find Server Rooms , and the light will remain green if the power is turned off to that room even with the breaker box off. The Liquid in the Grand Armory changes based on the moon it spawns on. Lockdown - when the apparatus is pulled, the separate platform it is on, if any, will fall into the liquid below. All fire exit doors will become locked and only accessible via the exterior, meaning the only way to get out is through the main entrance. The ceiling will be revealed to have spikes on it and begin to fall slowly, sometimes dropping a significant distance or increasing and decreasing in speed. If a player comes into contact with the top of the ceiling, they will be crushed for 999 damage. Once the ceiling has reached the floor, it will shortly rise back up and make the interior accessible again. However, the fire exit doors will remain locked. Swinging Hook - A hook that swings back and forth, dealing 25 damage to any player that comes into contact with the sharp point. Lurker - A hazard that sits behind a set of double doors, occasionally peeping out. If a player is in its line of sight, the doors will open revealing a flamethrower that will rapidly deal 10 damage per hit to players and entities. Liquid - Pools of hazardous liquid that emit a soft glow. What this liquid does varies. For example, the regular acid pools deal 999 damage per hit to a player that falls into them. Some act as quicksand. Regardless, falling into them usually results in death. The Missile Container that holds the reward. One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the Missile Container . If there is a red light on the satellite dish, players need to tune the radio frequencies. This can be done by finding cases with a dial on them inside Server Rooms with a small yellow light on them. The dial must be repeatedly turned until the sounds match each other and players must hit the green button when they match. Once all three frequencies are properly tuned, a sound effect will play and players can return to the Missile Container to get their reward. If the numbered button panel has a red light, players must find the Charging Station in the interior. Inside will be a sticky note on a cabinet that says a four digit code. Players can then return to the Missile Container , input the correct code, and get their reward. If both lights on the main panel are red, players must find a Shipping Container with a small yellow light on it. Inside that container will be a board of morse code and a device to input a code. Players must listen to the morse code sequence and determine what the code is by following the board. A circle indicates a short beep and a dash indicates a long beep. One strategy players can use is to only count and listen for when long beeps happen, as they are easier to discern from multiple short beeps. After inputting the correct code, players can press an emergency button to the right. A sound effect will play and players can return to the Missile Container to get their reward. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section. The Exterminator revealing itself. The Exterminator can randomly generate connected to a Cold Storage room. At the end of a grated hallway lies a caged area with five Skinned Thumpers hanging from hooks and an Advanced nightstick on the ground. Once any player enters far enough into this room, a door will abruptly shut behind them, the lights will flicker, the center thumper will be slammed to the ground, and all thumpers will be risen up into the ceiling. The Exterminator will then reveal itself at the front of and outside of the arena, resembling a much larger Lurker . Shortly afterward, a Skinned Thumper will be dropped into the arena. This is a variant of the Thumper with 12hp. The Advanced nightstick can be swung as a weapon with the additional property of stunning enemies for a short duration, making fighting the Skinned Thumper significantly easier. When a Skinned Thumper is killed, another Skinned Thumper will shortly be dropped into the arena and players must kill four of them in total. While the player fights the Skinned Thumpers , The Exterminator will be moving around the arena and attempting to attack players with four different attacks: Flamethrower - The Exterminator will open up one claw near the roof and begin spraying a flamethrower that tracks a player. It will rapidly deal 5 damage per hit to any player caught in it. Dual Flamethrower - The Exterminator will open up two claws near the roof and begin spraying a flamethrower from both, moving in a straight line across the arena. These flamethrowers will rapidly deal 10 damage per hit to players. Fan - The Exterminator will begin spinning a larger claw and slowly lowering it into the center of the arena, although it also loosely tracks a player. This fan will deal 999 damage per hit to any player hit by it while its spinning. Saws - The Exterminator will lower three sets of giant saws into and at the edge of the arena, moving them across the arena in a straight line. Any player that touches the blades will take 999 damage per hit. If players successfully kill all four Skinned Thumpers while surviving The Exterminator , the fifth and larger Skinned Thumper , now engulfed in flames, will shortly be dropped into the arena. It will ignore players and immediately run straight into the door that shut behind players when they entered the arena, dying and slightly popping it open. The Exterminator will begin one final attack by opening up five claws at the front of the arena and spewing flames from all of them, slowly moving them toward the back of the arena. These flames rapidly deal 80 damage per hit and players must interact with the door to open it and escape the arena before these flames reach them. The reward for this event is the Advanced nightstick players used to fight the Skinned Thumpers , ranging from ▮192 to ▮329. The primary appeal of this scrap is that it doubles as both a weapon and a stunning tool. It has approximately a 2s base stun duration, slightly better than a Radar-booster's stun, and also weighs significantly less than a Shovel at only 2lbs. However, it can not be put in a Belt bag and both its value and rarity as an event reward makes losing it significantly more impactful. A side view of the elevator. A Server Room. plain.p-gratar: Gratar was known for housing the biggest factory in the solar system. The whole facility was controlled by an AI made by a fantastic inventor last seen on Etern. As of recent, legend has it that the AI on Gratar has gone rogue. POPULATION: Killed. CONDITIONS: Warm, dry dirt terrain, supports plant life such as Fabaceae. FAUNA: A thriving Avian ecosystem, creatures support agressive behaviour. Gratar has several dirt mountains that extrude from a vast ocean below. Multiple waterfalls can also be seen falling down from the taller mountains around the exterior. The terrain itself is covered in bushes, grass, and trees. Bridges and ladders with lights nearby can be used for navigation and traversal. Several concrete structures and parts of the factory are visibile on the exterior, some of which are either the main entrance or fire exits. The main entrance is on top of the hill in front of the ship and across the bridge. Two fire exits are visibile to the northeast and southwest from the ship as well. The last regular fire exit is at the top of the hill to the left of the ship and requires either the cruiser (not recommended), two extension ladders, or a jetpack to reach from the exterior. Gratar can experience Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Forsaken weather by default. When Gratar is Flooded, large trees and branches will be present on the exterior, mainly in the middle of the moon. This does not affect any existing pathways or the moveable bridge, but does create new potential pathways for players to use. In the interior, the lights are red, the rogue AI, G. A. R. Y. , can be heard in the background, and the AI will play various voicelines. These voicelines can be used as a rough indicator for how much time has past, as most of them play roughly every 45-60 seconds, or every 1-1.5 hours of in-game time, while a player is inside the interior. Some additional lines are played when various things happen within the interior, such as the lights turning on or off. A broken bridge to the left of the main entrance can be pushed. Pushing the bridge will move it towards the right side of the ship temporarily before it falls into the water below, making it a one-time use. Players can stand on and place scrap on the bridge, so it can be useful for quickly getting scrap from the main entrance back to the ship or avoiding entities later in the day. Two lone fire exits can be found within the interior that lead to an area on the exterior where both of these fire exits are connected by a bridge. A natural fog surrounds this area when on the bridge or approaching it, but the bridge can be seen a little behind and to the right of the ship. This area is accessible via jetpack. A blue fire exit can also be found to the side of the main entrance that leads to a fabrication machine. Players can deposit Ingredient Items into the machine to craft Untampered operating panels , Triangulation devices , Double barrel shotguns , Shotgun shells , Adrenaline-stims , Health-stims , Pulatrum spore emitters , Boomboxes , Advanced flashlights , Fog reducers , Radar boosters , Action figures , Weed killer , De-weed , Pesticide sprinklers , Fabricated keys , and Single-barrel shotguns here. Note that there is a conversion rate for ingredients to resources (e.g., 1 Steel ingot equals 3 Steel), which is listed in the Ingredient Items section mentioned above. Any ingredients deposited into the machine will be saved even if players are fired and resources are shared with the machine on Galetry .
